## 10. From actual provision to a common connected source

### 10.1 Productive mediation and the local adequacy norm

Suppose A originally supplies a resource actually employed by a derived agent H in producing an effect. H's genuine agency does not turn that received resource into a new original stock. A therefore belongs in the effect's original productive account. This attribution concerns actual productive ancestry, not mere temporal priority, knowledge, proximity or covariance. It does not make H's utterance an assertion owned by A. [Productive mediation and source perfection, “Three attributions”][u-field]

Now suppose another original B supplies a requisite that A's actual undertaking uses. A's unused capacity to supply an alternative requisite does not provide the one actually used. Nor does an intermediary erase its original provenance. Calling a foreign productive input an “occasion” cannot remove its work; calling every explanatory condition a cause cannot establish productive donation either. Earlier acts, their resulting situations and later acts must remain distinct occurrences, even when the same bearer is involved. Collapsing them into a single bearer-node can manufacture a cycle. [Productive mediation and source perfection, “Shared products and later modification”][u-field]

The further normative premise is that complete unborrowed provision is the fitting mode of a qualified original's actual productive role. A transformation illustrates its force and its limit: A may supply the whole intrinsic transformative exercise while B supplies the material. That gives a correct causal account of incomplete original coverage. To classify A's chosen role as defective requires the additional adequacy norm. The word “undertaking” must not prejudge that classification by silently assigning the whole composite task to A. The retained positive rationale appeals to the excellence of actual, self-sufficient original efficacy. The retained dissent asks why a freely chosen less comprehensive role could not be fitting. Both must be represented. [Productive mediation and source perfection, “Independence and the perfection of actual exercise” and “The substantive dissent”][u-field]

### 10.2 An explicit propagation theorem

The conditional proof uses three different domains: sources, actual occurrences, and productive contributions. Let F be a selected field of occurrences. Write R(e,c) when contribution c is in the inventory of actual requisites of e, and O(s,c) when s entirely originally supplies c. Define:

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{Complete}(s,e)&\iff \forall c\,[R(e,c)\Rightarrow O(s,c)],\\
\mathrm{Participates}(s,e)&\iff \exists c\,[R(e,c)\land O(s,c)],\\
\mathrm{Overlap}(e,f)&\iff \exists c\,[R(e,c)\land R(f,c)].
\end{aligned}
```

The occurrence and contribution inventory must be interpreted independently. “Every supplied operative contribution is listed” cannot establish that the contribution domain contains all relevant reality. The applied account needs actual occurrence, sound and exhaustive requisites, the correct original level, the relevant productive history and all operative branches. These are interpretation obligations, not consequences of the graph. [Anchored-source interface and premise map][u-anchor] [Interpretation and premise map][u-premises]

Fix a qualified source g. Distinguish **classification** of a relevant incomplete role as defective from **conformance** of g's actual relevant roles to that norm. If every incomplete relevant role would be defective and no such role of g is defective, every relevant role is complete. This implication is a contradiction argument; it supplies no independent philosophical warrant for either premise. Further require:

- Represented participation in an admitted occurrence is a real original contribution there.
- Real original participation by g makes the adequacy norm applicable to g in that occurrence.
- g actually originally participates at an anchor a in F.
- Every occurrence in F can be reached from a by a finite sequence of overlaps within F.

**Coverage theorem.** Under those assumptions, g completely originally supplies every occurrence in F. Causal nonduplication is not required for this coverage conclusion.

**Proof.** The actual anchor and role-applicability premise make g's role at a relevant, hence complete. Suppose g is complete at e and e overlaps f through c. Then O(g,c), so g has represented participation at f. Use-soundness makes this real original participation, role-applicability makes it relevant, and adequacy of the role makes g complete at f. Induction along the finite overlap path from a proves completeness at every nominated occurrence. The path of length zero retains the anchor conclusion. No bound on the number of occurrences, temporal beginning, well-founded productive ancestry or qualification of rival sources is used. □ [Anchored-source interface, coverage proofs][u-anchor]

Overlap is symmetric incidence, not reverse efficient causation. For example, two earlier contributions can both be requisites of a later mixed occurrence; the overlap path connects the earlier accounts through that occurrence without asserting that the later occurrence caused its past. Conversely, an arbitrary drawn edge or common subject matter is not a productive overlap. [Anchored-source interpretation and review][u-anchor-guide] [Independent bridge review][u-anchor-review]

**Uniqueness extension.** Assume local nonduplication for every requisite in F: any two sources entirely originally supplying the same such c are identical. Every represented original participant in any occurrence of F then equals g.

**Proof.** If s participates through c, then O(s,c). Coverage gives O(g,c) for this same c. Nonduplication gives s = g. □

To extend this conclusion to **every actual original participant**, each must have a represented requisite witness. Call this visibility. Without it, an actual participant can be omitted from the inventory and evade the proof. The conclusion is about participation in F; an idle putative source or a source active only outside F is not identified by it. Global nonduplication is stronger than needed: only the nominated field's requisites enter the proof. [Anchored-source interface, represented and actual rival proofs][u-anchor]

There is a separate vacuity issue for a source merely labelled complete. If an occurrence has no listed requisite, every source satisfies its completeness predicate. To prove uniqueness of such complete providers, the occurrence must have at least one requisite. A visible actual anchor supplies one; every subsequent overlap supplies one at the next occurrence. Therefore all occurrences in the connected field have nonempty inventories. Two complete providers then share an actually listed c and are identical by nonduplication. For this narrower uniqueness result, a positive anchor inventory is sufficient; full visibility is one way of establishing it, not an irreducible additional requirement. [Anchored-source interface, positive-inventory proofs][u-anchor] [Independent bridge review][u-anchor-review]

The theorem also exposes how much the local norm does. With the fixed soundness, role, anchor and connectivity premises, satisfaction of the relevant completeness norm is equivalent to global coverage: the forward implication is the theorem, and the reverse implication is immediate by restriction to relevant roles. A participation-to-completeness formulation similarly becomes equivalent to coverage when the anchor has represented participation. This is useful transparency. It is not an independent proof of the norm or a reason to call the interpretation arbitrary. The philosophical arguments in sections 9–10.1 must do that work. [Anchored-source interface, equivalence proofs][u-anchor]

<a id="anchored-source-formal-fixture-boundary"></a>

The formal account retains each of these conditions separately: occurrence admissibility, sound and exhaustive requisites, represented-use soundness, role applicability, contributor visibility, qualification, defect classification, actual conformance, an actual anchor, overlap paths and field-scoped nonduplication. Its applied wrapper **assumes** admissibility and inventory soundness/exhaustiveness and returns them alongside coverage and the two uniqueness conclusions; propagation does not establish those interpretation conditions. The stronger global-nonduplication wrapper merely supplies field nonduplication. The separate existence statement is also explicit: coverage at the named $g$ furnishes $\exists s\,\mathrm{GlobalCoverage}(s)$, without nonduplication. ### 10.3 An abstract gluing result and its counterexamples

A shorter set formulation is helpful when complete local providers have already been established. For each target e in a nonempty field E, let U(e) be the set of sources completely adequate for e, with the same bearer identity and productive respect throughout. Suppose every U(e) is a singleton. Suppose a graph connects E by finite undirected paths and its used edges satisfy:

```math
U(e)\cap U(f)\ne\varnothing.
```

**Gluing theorem.** There is one source g such that U(e) = {g} for every e in E.

**Proof.** Choose an anchor e₀ and its unique provider g. Two singleton sets with a common member are equal. Equality therefore propagates along every finite path from e₀. All U(e) equal {g}. Existence comes from the nonempty anchor and its singleton; uniqueness follows at that anchor. No finite bound on E or choice of an infinite family of providers is needed. □ [Common-source comparison, §1][u-review]

This result must not replace its own hypotheses with weaker ones. Local **at-most-one** production does not supply an inhabitant of U(e). A relevant original resource is not already a complete provider. Ordinary causal interaction is not already overlap of complete provider sets. Topological connectedness under an unrelated topology is not graph connectivity. With several graph components, the proof gives a source per component, without deciding whether those sources agree. With E empty, all sources are vacuously globally adequate, so uniqueness can fail. A one-target field needs local existence and uniqueness but no edge. [Common-source comparison, §§1–4][u-review]

Without the singleton premise, even pairwise overlap does not suffice: {a,b}, {b,c} and {a,c} have nonempty pairwise intersections but no common member. A different sufficient theorem uses a compact source space with closed adequacy sets satisfying the **finite intersection property**. If their total intersection were empty, their open complements would cover the compact space; a finite subcover would contradict that property. This proves existence, not uniqueness. No philosophical application has established the required topology or compactness merely by using this theorem. [Common-source comparison, §1][u-review]

Under singletonhood, declaring a connected relation of “having the same provider” already amounts to declaring all providers equal. Independently evidenced sparse productive overlap can provide a useful argument; defining an agreement relation after the desired conclusion cannot provide new unity warrant. The gluing result is an exposition of an inherited conditional route, not a new discovery of the underlying philosophy. [Common-source comparison, §§1, 3–4][u-review]

<a id="t20-modal-equality-contract-controls"></a>

**The fixed equality language and its controls.** The modal-union review contract has two separate assertions. For every frame $F:\mathrm{Frame}(V,W)$, with $V:\mathrm{Type}\ u$ and $W:\mathrm{Type}\ w$, the class $\mathrm{FaithfulInterpretation}(F)$ is nonempty. Its displayed witness is the identity expansion of the component quotient, $\mathrm{Quotient}(\mathrm{componentSetoid}(F))$, using the component map and its edge law. Nonemptiness prevents the following universal assertion from being explained merely by an empty interpretation class. The exact characterization itself is

```math
\left[\forall S:\mathrm{Type}\ u\;\forall a:V\to S,
 \left(\forall z,p,q,\ F.\mathrm{admissible}(z)\to
 F.\mathrm{crossing}(z,p,q)\to a(p)=a(q)\right)
 \to a(x)=a(y)\right]
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \mathrm{Connected}(F,x,y),
```

for every frame $F$ and every $x,y\in V$. The quantified codomain is any type in the stated universe, not one preselected carrier; the premise is imposed only on crossings at admissible indices. The source invokes `forcedEqual_iff_connected` for this equivalence. The conclusion concerns equality in that fixed language. It does not establish equality for arbitrary enriched relations, cross-world numerical identity of bearers, or metaphysical realizability of the frame. The selected contract requests axiom reports for both declarations, but the request is not the report: neither their axiom output nor a fresh Lean check is supplied here. [R250-036, lines 3–22][R250-036]

The companion negative-control file attempts exactly three claims with `by decide`: `switchedLocal 2 1 = switchedAnchor 1`; $\forall s,t:\mathrm{Bool}$, `collapsingTransport true s = collapsingTransport true t → s = t`; and `chainFrame.crossing 1 1 2`. Its comment calls these false finite claims that the kernel-producing decision procedure must reject. The equality, universally quantified injectivity claim and specified indexed crossing are retained as three different targets. The selected file does not contain the imported `FiniteControls` definitions or an execution receipt. These are therefore precisely identified rejection targets, not three newly established negation theorems or evidence that the expected rejection occurred. [R250-022, lines 1–6][R250-022]

The historical formal map sharpens the adjacent ancestry comparison. For an inhabited domain with one irreflexive transitive ancestry relation r, universal local complete cover together with connectedness by finite undirected paths is **equivalent** to existence of a least ancestor; the domain need not be finite. The reverse direction obtains local coverage and paths from the least ancestor directly. The independent reviewer proof of the forward direction starts with one local cover at a chosen base and transports that cover along paths, avoiding a globally chosen source-selection function. These are retained positive proof routes, not new kernel executions. [T750-C726]

At a fixed target x, existence of a local cover is equivalent to a unique root ancestor of x **and** root ancestry for every y below x. At all targets simultaneously, universal unique root ancestry implies that support condition for each ancestral y, so it is equivalent to universal local completeness. The pointwise and universal statements cannot be interchanged. An infinite connected fork can have one root and a unique root ancestor of its target while another branch in that target's cone remains unsupported. Conversely, a rooted infinite descending subordinate branch shows that global well-foundedness is unnecessary for the common least-ancestor theorem. Reflexive self-cover still supplies no productive act. [T750-C726]

Actual sourcehood requires the independently interpreted actual domain, complete incoming history and the same productive respect throughout. Graph `Root`, modal existence/nonreceipt, `HistoryComplete`, `UnborrowedActs` and `ProductiveWitness` are distinct predicates with distinct owners. The map supplies no general conversion of nonduplication or the source-mode norm into universal ancestral cover. Its Sixth P1/P2 mean faithful ancestry/local completeness, whereas later foundational P1/P2 mean whole original completion/particular bearer identification. Preserving those scopes supports the affirmative interpretation below without claiming that its application premises were proved by renaming a graph. [T750-C726]

**Directed prerequisite propagation has its own exact scope condition.** Fix a seed set S and a prerequisite relation R, where R(x,y) means that supplying x requires supplying y. Let E(S,R) be the least set containing S and closed under that rule. Every R-closed set containing S covers the whole declared domain if and only if E(S,R) itself covers that domain. In one direction choose E(S,R); in the other, induction on the closure construction places every envelope member in any such set. Thus seed completeness plus this unary propagation rule yields whole-domain completeness exactly when the envelope exhausts that domain. The minimality is relative to the stated rule, not an absolutely weakest metaphysical premise. [C250-236]

The source gives a concrete separation from undirected connectivity. Two always-existing partial enablers supply, respectively, an arithmetic output 4 and a Boolean output true; their actual cooperation produces the pair (4,true). Each alone fails to produce that joint token. Individual completeness is locally exclusive and closed under prerequisites, and the three tokens form an undirected connected hub. Nevertheless, the prerequisite envelope of the arithmetic token contains only that token: edges run from the joint product to its two inputs, not backward. All actual tokens are genuinely produced, but neither partial enabler completely supplies the field. This tests the passage from weaker local premises to universal coverage, not the already-granted role of a complete unconditioned universal source or the metaphysical possibility of the displayed interpretation. ### 10.4 The affirmative judgment and its exact scope

The current public appraisal affirms one complete original source of the relevant actual productively connected created order at a defeasible research standard. Its reasons combine original actuality, necessity and independence with actual adequate efficacy, the original mode's perfection, faithful mediation and local nonduplication. This is stronger than an unspecified preference. It is not a demonstration of the impossibility of every plural-original reality. The conditional theorems show how particular premises support coverage and identity; they neither create the cumulative warrant nor retract it because some premises remain philosophically disputed. [Public source-unity judgment][u-judgment] [Common-source comparison, §§3–4][u-review]

The surviving reservation concerns unrestricted application of the efficacy norm to every proposed primitive, voluntarily joint original manifestation. The strongest proposed rival has genuine restricted explanatory and agency credits, but no independently warranted full original-perfection certificate. Failure to exhibit such a certificate is not itself a proof of unity. A well-directed undercutter need not provide a complete competing cosmos. A disconnected active original, an idle putative original, all possible realities and universal mastery over every possible peer require distinct arguments. A result for the nominated actual field should neither be erased nor extended to them silently. [Public source-unity judgment][u-judgment] [Productive mediation and source perfection, scope of the field conclusion][u-field]

E231–234 joins diversity arising from shared materials, reciprocal organ functions, differentiated human trades, continuity through replacement and local agents serving wider ends they do not individually represent. E233 expressly describes an organizer of many agents' actual acts, making some causes and ends for others. The inference is richer than repeated regularity: one wise source can explain the accommodation of heterogeneous contributions within one comprehensive determination. Its economy concerns fewer independent facts about original role allocation and coordination, not merely fewer names. The source's premise that every relevant resource originates from that one bearer remains stronger than common coordination alone. The e232 plural-gods/kings conditional has a recorded missing consequent; intact surrounding reasons retain their force without a conjectural repair. <a id="third-cohort-b-anchored-infinite-field"></a>

**The guarded propagation is not restricted to finite tables.** The independent anchored-source control makes two positive implications explicit. Suppose a designated source g completely covers every occurrence in the nominated field, a positive requisite occurs at an anchor a, and every field occurrence is connected to a by the account's overlap paths. Positivity propagates along the finite path to each occurrence. Field nonduplication then identifies every other complete provider there with g. Separately, use soundness turns the positive represented provision by g into its actual participation at each occurrence. Label uniqueness and actual participation therefore consume different premises; neither is inferred merely from a connected drawing. [T750B649]

The same source supplies a countably infinite occurrence–requisite example. Occurrence n requires respects n and n+1. Consecutive occurrences share respect n+1, so induction constructs a path from occurrence 0 to every n. The source g provides all respects, and the interpretation, qualification, conformance, visibility, actual anchor and nonduplication conditions are supplied. Applying the guarded theorem yields global coverage, actual uniqueness in that account and uniqueness of each complete provider. The number of occurrences is genuinely infinite; this is not an enumeration of a finite table. It is also not a metaphysical possibility certificate for an alternative ontology.

The controls locate the interpretation burden. An empty field can make connectivity and coverage vacuous without producing an anchor or source. A real but invisible anchor does not supply represented coverage. Coverage of the recorded requisites does not certify that no operative requisite was omitted. Widening the field can destroy both coverage and its nonduplication condition; two qualified disconnected components need not share a provider. The positive infinite example retains these guards rather than weakening them. Deliberate overclaim fixtures additionally reject arbitrary-graph provision, unrestricted outside-source exclusion and transfer from causal provision to owned assertion. Their expected rejection is not a newly executed result. These distinctions preserve the affirmative source-unity argument at its warranted scope and do not demote it because a weaker graph formalism omits its premises. [T750B600] [T750B612] [T750B621] [T750B649]

**The positive textual argument and the later comparative judgment.** The received *Ṣafadiyya* materials do contain an affirmative argument for one actual common Creator. S003L198–208 appeals to the world's connectedness and mutual need against assigning its interdependent products to independently complete makers. L362–365 then distinguishes the one generated human, horse or tree from ordinary collaborators' distinguishable acts; L368–373 tests the inseparability of mixing and the resulting mixture. These are intended exclusions, not an aesthetic preference for saying “one.” A reconstruction must still defend the actual connection, individuation and inseparability invoked, and show why the relevant maker-dependence follows. It must not silently replace a partial contribution with complete production, or infer borrowed intrinsic power merely from a jointly attained end. The same source distinguishes reciprocal efficient empowerment from harmless concomitance and created cooperation. [F250-A067-666-675] [F250-A067-712-741] [F250-A000-9-29] [F250-A069-55-87]

The dated threshold audit helps specify why the current affirmative appraisal in this section survives that distinction. It separates three propositions: **N**, an actual particular bearer with whole-existence originality, intrinsic necessity and relevant efficacy; **C**, one bearer's complete original provision of the actual connected field; and **S**, exhaustive unborrowed sourcehood for every possible qualified original in every relevant exercise. It accepts N and, with lower confidence, C, while withholding S. C includes material, productive and preserving requisites through genuine derivative agents. An organizer of independently original materials does not meet that target, and putting several originals inside one explanatory box does not individuate one bearer. [F250-A008-5-37]

The residual affirmative case joins an already warranted original resource, differentiated interdependence and adequate integrative agency. It charges the enlargement to comprehensive agency as a real cost of C. It then asks whether another independently original bearer and an allocation of original roles do explanatory work that the unified account cannot do. Shared wisdom can explain matching ends without yet fixing differentiated means or original ownership. But the comparison may not presume statistically independent wills, probable quarrelling or a separate coincidence at every fit; one source also owes a determinate explanation, and complexity common to both accounts cannot be charged twice to plurality. The claimed advantage is a substantive, defeasible integration-and-economy judgment, not an entity count standing alone. [F250-A008-39-71]

Its principal vulnerability is the move from integrated provision to a genuinely single original agency of the required scope. An independently motivated plural allocation with comparable economy could weaken C. So could a conceptual diagnosis showing that the single-agent proposal merely hides the same unexplained matching, without the critic furnishing a complete rival cosmos or proving a plural world possible. These conditions preserve the actual affirmative judgment and its revisability together. The earlier post-*Nubuwwāt* supplement really did withhold sufficient numerical discrimination at its narrower stage; the later audit and final guide revised the weighting without claiming that a quotation, a formal replay or agreement among assessors forced assent. Their shared sources and AI authorship are not independent human-specialist corroboration. [F250-A008-73-95] [F250-A218-7-38] [F250-A195-1-31] [F250-A100-451-465] [F250-A223-1-9]

The later 7 October 2026, 14:34 appraisal makes the chronology explicit. It retains provisional sufficient-warrant acceptance of an actual Necessary Being and revises the 08:40 common-source withholding to provisional acceptance of **one complete original source of this actual connected created order**, with lower confidence in the latter. The positive comparison is cumulative: original existential provision and adequate knowing agency already have reasons; a single genuine bearer can account for that provision and its integrated employment while preserving real secondary causes. Dividing ultimate ownership adds a commitment without a presently established explanatory gain requiring the division. This is a defeasible comparative judgment, not merely a report that a formal framework has a conditional consequence. [F250-C116] [F250-C124]

The revision does not make comprehensive competence free. An organizing-only agent does not thereby originate its materials; a committee cannot be turned into one bearer by a name. Shared unexplained world detail must be charged to both accounts. A sufficiently clear demonstration that the single-source hypothesis conceals the same coordination, or that its comprehensive competence costs more than the plurality it removes, could defeat it without a complete rival cosmology. The assessor's narrower correction is that preserving much of the same fit through necessary harmony had been assigned more defeating weight than justified. Agreement among assessors is not additional evidence for the conclusion. [F250-C116] [F250-C124]

The same records continue to withhold sufficient warrant for universal **SourceMode**, exclude no unrelated necessary reality by this actual-field inference, and neither authenticate a revelation nor re-adjudicate every earlier essential-attribute result.
