### 12.5 Original efficacy and the positive argument for cognition

The preceding account of practical conformance can be extended into a connected argument about Power, Knowledge, Will, Wisdom and disclosure. The extension has an affirmative centre: an original adequate to the actual cognitive and practical excellence it supplies has reason to be understood as originally cognitive and capable of informed action. Its force depends on the substantive account of adequacy, eligibility and practical excellence. Productive relations alone express less. Keeping those premises visible preserves the positive argument and specifies what a counterexample would have to retain to challenge it. The following reconstruction reconciles [*Original sourcehood and the independent warrants for agency wisdom and disclosure*][kg-attributes], [*Complete self knowledge and Knowledge of created effects*][kg-effects], and [*Exact sourcehood with actual Knowledge and a standing Knowledge boundary*][kg-modal] with the later affirmative assessment of comprehensive Knowledge. Their exact public source identities appear in the edition note below.

Start with a genuine episode of rational correction. A subject apprehends a determinate error and changes an assessment because of that apprehension. Existence, content, truth and the operative reason for correction are distinct aspects of the explanandum. A changed output by itself does not establish this episode. Nor does the failure of an explanation that presupposes the determinacy it claims to originate identify a concrete producer. Sections 1–11 supply the positive received-actuality, same-bearer necessity and original-provision arguments at their stated scopes. The attribute argument uses that result; it does not extract an original knower from a local explanatory prohibition.

**Actual efficacy gives a scoped positive result.** If g actually produces e in respect r, g is not powerless with respect to that realized exercise. A merely passive description, permission or conduit cannot replace the efficacious actuality whose occurrence is at issue. This establishes more than an empty label, but it does not establish that g can perform every task, act effortlessly, produce either of two alternatives, or disclose anything. Those are different claims about its power. The source's stronger perfection argument identifies inability as a privation where a genuinely possible, nondefective exercise is eligible for the original; it then argues that the adequate original cannot be inferior in that eligible excellence. Its application to unrestricted Power therefore requires a warranted domain of tasks and joint compatibility of the attributed abilities. The comparison in *al-Akmaliyya* expressly restricts its subject to possible perfection without defect. [Ibn Taymiyya, *Majmūʿ*, VI, 76–79 and 85–87][kg-mf6]

This task restriction has logical content. For mutually exclusive outcomes A and B, $`\Diamond A\land\Diamond B`$ need not imply $`\Diamond(A\land B)`$. Being able to realize either outcome does not mean being able to realize their contradictory conjunction in the same respect. Conversely, not willing a realizable outcome does not establish inability to produce it. The attribute study preserves this distinction from *al-Ṣafadiyya*'s comparison of standing ability and complete exercise; it does not convert every unperformed description into a genuine task. A universal power claim needs more than repeated instances of actual efficacy.

There are also three senses of completeness. **Productive completeness** concerns the whole relevant provision of an effect's actuality. **Contrastive determination** concerns why this outcome occurs among alternatives. **Cognitive comprehension** concerns actual apprehension of the relevant content. A completely supplied chance process may leave a particular outcome undetermined by the specified initial conditions. A fully determinate noncognitive power may select one outcome without apprehending it. Even a source that both knows and produces may require a further relation connecting its cognition to its exercise. None of these distinctions deprives a richer account of its explanatory force; they prevent one sense of completeness from silently supplying another.

The original-giver argument adds a specifically cognitive warrant. Truth apprehension is a positive achievement of its bearer. When that achievement is wholly received, an independently complete original must account for it in its distinctive respect. Ordinary unlike-cause examples have limited force here: a sculptor's not being triangular and a parent's not having a child's height concern partial causation or creaturely restrictions, rather than complete original provision of a pure cognitive excellence. Eligibility separates apprehension itself from prior ignorance, sensory dependence, fatigue, discursive acquisition and error. Being directed towards an object also need not mean receiving one's cognitive perfection from an independent donor: the object can be the knower itself or its own product.

The crucial further judgment is **respect-specific original-giver priority**: if an intrinsic excellence is independently eligible for the original, the complete original giver cannot be wholly inferior to its recipient in that very excellence. Greater productive range is not greater apprehension. A power to originate many knowers is a productive ability; its being cognitive remains a separate question. On the defended priority judgment, genuine received cognition, complete original giving and cognitive eligibility support actual original Knowledge. This is a substantive explanation of why cognition belongs at the source, not a definition of the productive relation. “Intellectual” here identifies genuine apprehension; it does not identify a separate hypostasis, a creaturely reasoning process or a particular revealed Name.

A positive noncognitive rival must nevertheless be granted its proposed intrinsic nature and powers. It need not be inert or depend on an external lawgiver. The weaker demand for an adequate positive basis does not, by itself, prove that every such basis apprehends truth. Calling the basis only “whatever produces cognition” leaves its distinctive explanatory character unspecified; a developed theory of intrinsic powers and normative teleology is a stronger competitor. The cognitive account earns its own explanatory credit when apprehension, intended target and efficacy are genuinely connected. It still owes an account of producing a numerically distinct knower; knowledge alone does not do that work. This is the retained philosophical dispute about original cognitive adequacy, rather than a formal contradiction in bare noncognition.

### 12.6 Actual cognition, standing Knowledge and intrinsic determination

The original-giver inference has different actual, modal and essential forms. Let W be a nonempty set of represented worlds, u the same designated source throughout, and $`C_w(u,x)`$ complete original sourcehood of x at w. Let $`K_w(s,p)`$ mean that subject s genuinely knows content p at w, and put $`H_w(s)\iff\exists p\,K_w(s,p)`$. These cognitive predicates are semantic premises. A finite table or a correct output does not establish their application to an actual subject.

The weakest worldwise cognitive priority used in the modal source is

```math
\forall w\,\forall x\;\bigl(C_w(u,x)\land H_w(x)\bigr)\Longrightarrow H_w(u).
```

It is existential priority: some cognition in a completely dependent recipient warrants some cognition in the giver. It does not say that every content known by the recipient is transferred to the source. From an actual cognitive recipient it immediately yields actual source cognition. If every represented world contains such a recipient, it yields $`\forall w\,H_w(u)`$. Neither inference requires an exchange of source bearers.

**A productive three-world control.** Take worlds a, b and c, all mutually accessible, and entities $`u,r,k_a,k_b,z`$. The existence and cognitive tables are:

| World | Existing entities | True cognitive ascriptions | Recipient-owned thought |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| a | $`u,r,k_a`$ | $`K_a(r,p),K_a(u,p)`$ | r owns $`k_a`$ |
| b | $`u,r,k_b`$ | $`K_b(r,p),K_b(u,p)`$ | r owns $`k_b`$ |
| c | $`u,z`$ | none | none |

Let p be true and q false. All unlisted cognitive ascriptions are false. Define $`C_w(s,x)`$ and productive dependence by $`s=u`$, x existing at w and $`x\ne u`$. Thus u exists everywhere, has no incoming productive dependence, and is the unique root at every world. Each other entity fails to exist somewhere and is received whenever it exists. The union of all dependence edges is a star rooted at u, so both worldwise dependence and its modal union are well founded.

The control also preserves an actual productive witness. At a introduce original modes for r and $`k_a`$, together with a derivative local mode of r for $`k_a`$; do the corresponding thing at b, and introduce an original mode for z at c. A mode belongs only to its displayed world and target. u accounts for every mode, and only u properly exercises an original mode. No subject properly exercises a derivative mode in the unborrowed sense. History-complete accounting holds because every mode of every completely supplied target is accounted for by u. Unborrowed-act exclusion holds because both an original mode's proper bearer and its complete account are u. Every complete target has an original productive witness. At c, in particular, u actually produces z through its proper original mode. The world without cognition is not an empty or inactive-source world.

Every cognitive ascription is factive and has an existing subject. At a and b, the only cognitive recipient is r and u also knows, so cognitive priority holds. At c its antecedent fails: z has no cognition. From every world a is accessible, so possible cognitive giving holds everywhere. If $`I(w)`$ is the intrinsic activation condition “w is a or b,” the same response law $`H_w(u)\leftrightarrow I(w)`$ holds throughout, without an external producer of u. Yet $`H_c(u)`$ is false. Actual Knowledge, worldwise actual-giver priority, necessary source existence, possible cognitive giving everywhere and absence of an external supplier therefore do not entail standing Knowledge on this relational class. ∎

The source's cognition at a and b does not make u the owner of r's thought tokens. Original productive accounting and mental ownership remain different relations. The older interpretation used an entirely noncognitive source; this control changes that cognitive interpretation while retaining the productive definitions. Its old denial of all source cognition cannot also be asserted of the new table. The construction is a relative consistency result for the displayed premises, not a proof that this profile is metaphysically possible under the full pure-perfection doctrine.

**Positive intrinsic-determination result.** Let $`E_w(u)`$ mean that u exists and $`N_w(u)`$ that its relevant intrinsic nature is present. Suppose

```math
\forall w\,E_w(u),\qquad
\forall w\,(E_w(u)\Longrightarrow N_w(u)),\qquad
\forall w\,(N_w(u)\Longrightarrow H_w(u)).
```

Then $`\forall w\,H_w(u)`$: for arbitrary w, apply the second and third premises to the first. The result is elementary, but it identifies the stronger premise exactly. If the third implication expresses complete intrinsic determination of standing cognitive excellence, the philosophical account explains its essential possession. A universal quantifier alone supplies no such explanation. To make the comparison exact, set $`N_w(u)`$ true at every world of the activation control: the first two premises hold and the third fails at c. Whether that constant description captures the complete adequate original nature is precisely what the finite interpretation does not certify.

The affirmative source rationale is that the original's cognitive adequacy does not acquire its eligibility from a recipient's arrival. Recipient cognition reveals an original excellence; it does not first create the source's title to it. On the defended pure-perfection account, standing cognitive adequacy is intrinsic and unborrowed, while particular acts occur in their fitting relations. This is stronger than the disjunction “possibly cognitive and not externally completed.” That disjunction leaves open an internally varying activation condition. The intrinsic-determination argument addresses that alternative by its account of the original nature, rather than by misclassifying every internal transition as external receipt.

A related argument excludes **total deliberate or inferential self-bestowal of cognition**. Deliberately undertaking to make oneself cognitive presupposes apprehension of the undertaking; inferring one's first cognition presupposes cognition of premises and their bearing. Neither accounts for the whole cognitive actuality from none. Instruction by an independently supplying knower is a different received route. These arguments do not alone exclude an alleged involuntary noncognitive-to-cognitive transition. They also distinguish a first temporal onset, later loss and an alternative history with no cognition. A rule prohibiting onset can allow an indefinitely cognitive past followed by loss; adding a no-loss rule still permits a separate history that is noncognitive throughout. Standing Knowledge across alternatives needs the stronger source-nature warrant. The public study's distinction between intrinsic attributes and renewed acts preserves that warrant without making every particular cognitive act eternal.

Cognition-specific termination has a further scope boundary. A chain of teachers whose members receive instruction can terminate in an uninstructed thinker whose existence and powers are nevertheless productively received. If the predecessor relation means original bestowal of cognition, the rule that the predecessor must know is already a stronger cognitive premise. The original-giver argument offers a rationale for that premise; a change in the meaning of “teacher” does not prove it. Likewise, an identity theorem can transport Knowledge from an already cognitive bearer along an established identity, but cannot create the cognitive premise. These source distinctions remain intact when the stronger essential conclusion is affirmatively defended.

### 12.7 Complete self-Knowledge and the particular effect

Once original cognition is established, complete self-Knowledge can support knowledge of effects. Let A describe the source's **actual complete productive determination** in the respect at issue and X its effect or a determinate property of that effect. In the intended application, A includes the actual exercise and relevant contribution, not merely a standing capacity or a general law. The source must genuinely apprehend that determination and its relevant efficacy.

**Known-determination proposition.** For a cognitive predicate K satisfying the displayed closure rule,

```math
K(A\Rightarrow X)\land K(A)\Longrightarrow K(X),
```

knowledge of A and knowledge that A suffices for X imply knowledge of X.

**Proof.** Apply the stated closure rule to the two premises. No initial cognition, factivity, causal efficacy or knowledge of the implication is generated by the proof. Those enter through the interpretation and hypotheses. ∎

This minimal proof is useful because it displays rather than conceals the load carried by “complete.” A chance-generating mechanism may determine a distribution without determining its realized sample. A known general capacity may permit several actual exercises. An omitted co-contribution may affect the effect's properties. In those cases A does not yet entail the proposed X. Conversely, when the actual complete determination includes the relevant particular properties and the source comprehends its efficacy, limiting the conclusion to “something exists” understates the argument.

A complementary information formulation separates determination from cognition. For a state description $`s:W\to S`$, define

```math
D_s^w(\varphi)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\forall v\in W\;\bigl(s(v)=s(w)\Longrightarrow\varphi(v)\bigr).
```

If the effect description is $`e=f\circ s`$, then $`D_s^w(e=e(w))`$. For any v with $`s(v)=s(w)`$, applying f gives $`e(v)=e(w)`$. Moreover, $`D_s^w`$ is factive because w has its own state, and it is closed under pointwise implication by applying both premises at the same v. These are properties of an information partition. They do not establish that any bearer apprehends the information.

For the finite contrast, let $`s(a)=s(b)=\mathrm{produce\ recipient}`$ and $`s(c)=\mathrm{produce\ other}`$, with corresponding effects recipient and other. Let the generic standing nature $`n(w)=*`$ be constant. The actual determination s fixes the effect at each world. The standing nature n does not: at a its fibre includes c, where the effect differs. Thus a claim using s cannot be refuted by substituting the weaker n. Nor does naming two state values establish that those values exhaust the metaphysically possible complete determinations of an actual source.

The implication also preserves two distinct kinds of content. Knowing $`A\Rightarrow X`$ is not already knowing that X occurs: a conditional can be known without its antecedent. But if A is introduced solely as “the completed bringing-about of this X,” much of the target has been placed in the description. Al-Rāzī's objection in the *Darʾ* discussion distinguishes thin self-knowledge from knowledge of the causal relation, questioning the former implication and charging the latter with presupposing its effect. [*Darʾ*, electronic division 017][kg-dar17] A substantive application must independently warrant the particular determination and the source's comprehension of it. The finite production function only illustrates the consequence of those conditions.

The historical argument is expressly noninferential with respect to the source. In *Darʾ*, the self-Knowledge premise is distinguished from creation by Knowledge, Will and Power; the author's clarification also distinguishes our entailment argument from the source learning through deduction. The particular-production discussion extends the target to determinate properties, including dimensions and quantity. [*Darʾ*, electronic division 017, selected self-Knowledge and particular-production passages][kg-dar17] In the reconstruction, one cognition does not efficiently produce another. Our proof shows the incompatibility of complete apprehension of the relevant determination with ignorance of its known consequence; it does not narrate a divine sequence of premise consultation, uncertainty and discovery.

There is no modal collapse in this implication. Even $`\Box(A\Rightarrow X)`$ and actual A do not give $`\Box X`$. A different world can contain B and Y. For a particular intentional effect, the stronger original profile also supplies positive evidence of particular cognitive direction: an intention directed only at a general type does not by itself pick out this realization. Yet ordinary successful human intention can contain error or ignorance under other descriptions. The application therefore retains the original's independently defended cognitive adequacy and complete productive scope; it is not a general inference from any successful behavior to exhaustive knowledge of its object.

**Composed coverage consequence.** Fix one source u and a set F of effect-contents belonging to its warranted productive field. Suppose that for every $`X\in F`$ there is an actual determination $`A_X`$ for which u knows $`A_X`$ and $`A_X\Rightarrow X`$, and that the stated closure applies. Then u knows every $`X\in F`$.

**Proof.** Choose arbitrary $`X\in F`$, use its own warranted determination and apply the known-determination proposition. Universal generalization over F gives the result. The same u is retained throughout. Enlarging F requires the corresponding coverage and cognitive premises. ∎

This is a composition of the source's conditional effect argument, not a new independent discovery of cognition, complete coverage or omniscience. It also distinguishes $`\forall w\,\exists p\,K_w(u,p)`$ from $`\exists p\,\forall w\,K_w(u,p)`$, and both from comprehensive knowledge at every world. In a two-world control, let only p be true and known at the first world and only q at the second. There is cognition in each world but no one content known in both. Which contents must be invariant is a further substantive question; standing cognitive adequacy need not be represented by a frozen inventory of every particular act.

### 12.8 Comprehensive Knowledge and the separate perfection argument

The effect argument is not the whole affirmative case. The later public study, [*Particular productive knowledge and comprehensive cognitive perfection*][kg-comprehensive], explicitly endorses a separate pure-perfection route to comprehensive Knowledge. Its distinction is substantive: production is evidence of being known within the adequate original profile, not a necessary condition of being known. Knowledge of the source itself, nonactual possibilities and the impossibility of a proposed state need not be knowledge of a produced object. The modal control in §12.6 tests weaker premises and does not satisfy this stronger perfection account.

The positive argument proceeds from an independently established original and a defended cognitive standard. Adequate apprehension is an intelligible excellence. Removing a finite knower's need for instruction, organs, storage or labor does not remove that positive achievement. If a genuine truth were unknown to this same original, apprehending it as true in an eligible mode would remove a cognitive omission. On the unrestricted pure-perfection judgment, an arbitrary content boundary supplies no sufficient reason to withhold that eligible excellence from the original. Hence no such omission remains. The appraisal retained here is affirmative and defeasible: the excellence of apprehension, its independence from a foreign donor and the answers to the specified creaturely-cost objections give substantive reason to accept comprehensive Knowledge.

This is neither an induction from a long list of known effects nor an inference from repeatedly adding one item to a finite learner until an infinite maximum is reached. It applies one general perfection criterion to an arbitrary alleged omission. The criterion is doing real philosophical work. Truth alone does not cause a cognition, and consistency of a set of truths alone does not prove that an actual subject jointly apprehends them. The defended eligibility claim concerns their nondefective cognitive possession in the same original, without an imposed finite-resource trade-off. A demonstrated incompatibility would challenge that claim; the mere label “a nature that knows only these things” does not independently justify the restriction.

Eligibility also limits what the comprehensive conclusion says. It does not require believing contradictions true, falsely identifying oneself with every other subject, producing mutually exclusive possibilities together, or acquiring a creature's deficient manner of learning. Knowing that an impossible state is impossible does not make it exist. Knowing what follows under a specified supposition does not assert the supposition. Knowing a genuine unrealized possibility does not actualize it. No new ontology of independently existing impossible objects or universal semantics of counterpossibles follows.

The relevant *Darʾ* passage distinguishes the quoted objection from the author's reply, endorses the all-versus-some comparison, and rejects making productive causation a necessary condition of knowledge. [*Darʾ*, electronic division 017, nonactual-object and cognitive-perfection passages][kg-dar17] The later study's printed-page control at X, 150–152 is inherited here; this continuation directly checked the specified electronic passages, not that scan. Older statements that omniscience remained outside a particular formal packet describe that packet's range. They do not repeal the later positive philosophical conclusion or turn a thin relational countermodel into a counterexample to its additional premises.

### 12.9 Informed willing and the scope of necessitation

An original's having Knowledge and efficacy does not yet express the relation between them. Consider a source with a perfectly accurate cognitive representation and an independently specified productive law, where changing which contents are apprehended would make no difference to the law's exercise. This accompanying-cognition model separates co-possession from guidance. It is not a refutation of an original whose practical perfection is already granted. It identifies the extra relation: the exercise occurs through apprehension of a fitting end and means, with the cognition genuinely relevant to why this action occurs.

The positive agency argument starts from rational correction as an integrated excellence. A correction made because an error is understood has both semantic and practical organization. If that whole excellence is received, if its positive form is eligible for the original without creaturely deficiency, and if original-giver priority applies to the integrated achievement, its original provision supports informed agency. The constructive account connects adequate apprehension of a target, recognition of fitting means and effective willing of a distinct recipient capable of the intended cognition. It thereby offers an explanation of why the recipient's activity is directed towards the relevant truth. These are richer premises than successful output or the word “mind.” Cross-context flexibility may be evidence within such an account; it is not a demonstrated exclusivity theorem that only a mind could exhibit any such pattern.

The source comparison distinguishes four relations: standing capacity for an act; a particular intention; the reason making the act fitting; and a complete exercise including effective Power and determinate Will. A reason need not be the entire productive condition. A determinate act need not be preceded by a temporally earlier, externally supplied act of willing. Conversely, a single realized alternative does not by itself establish psychological choice: chance, intrinsic determination and interacting powers can also yield one outcome. The affirmative willing argument retains practical direction and relevant cognition rather than extracting agency from bare differentiation.

The discussion in *al-Ṣafadiyya* allows a complete source characterized by Power, Will and act to necessitate its effect without thereby being an unwilled cause. [*Al-Ṣafadiyya*, electronic division 002, complete determination and choice][kg-safadiyya] Formally, necessity of the connection $`A\Rightarrow X`$ does not establish necessity of A. Likewise, the perfection of acting at an appropriate occasion does not require all successive acts to occur together or eternally. [*Majmūʿ*, VI, 85–87][kg-mf6] A beginningless succession of intrinsically exercised acts is not, merely by being successive, a chain of borrowed essential perfection.

**Particular determination and accomplished activity.** The inherited wise-determination return develops the positive account through intrinsic Life, Knowledge, Power, Will and Wisdom, apprehension of fitting ends, and actual particular willing with its effective conditions. An original’s own prior acts can contribute to those conditions without a peer supplying its agency. In the reported *Shifāʾ* e176–177 discussion, power plus knowledge of benefit is insufficient: a conflicting preference may prevent willing the known benefit. *Miftāḥ* 953–955 also allows attachment to fitting action through the subject’s own wise choice, rather than external compulsion. These are constructive explanatory relations, not merely labels for a selected outcome. The e213 parity reply has a narrower role than the positive account of powers, causes and ends at e206. [WISE-PARTICULAR]

Three claims about underdetermination must therefore be separated. Our stated reasons may be incomplete; that does not establish an ontological tie. Normative fittingness may permit several options while a particular intrinsic willing and its adequate determining basis settle the occurrence; the cited creaturely equal-option example does not establish an actual divine tie or specify its resolution. Finally, an unchanged and indifferent **complete particular determining situation** cannot explain a newly specified outcome merely by adding an unexplained choice label. The source’s complete-determiner principle rejects that third claim. It neither proves that every complete normative reason-set has a unique optimum nor licenses a primitive divine tie-breaker. The strongest nonnecessitating rival nevertheless deserves its actual positive description: knowledgeable purposive agency produces this choice for an adequate, nonunique reason. Its point of disagreement is whether that particular exercise needs a further adequate differentiating basis, not whether it has any reason or producer. [WISE-PARTICULAR]

The regress issue has an equally exact premise. *Shifāʾ* e174 presents a volition-regress dilemma in the opponent’s voice; the respondent at e175 explains why a **created subject that began to exist** cannot contain a beginningless personal history. Novelty of a token act does not preserve that finite-bearer premise when the argument is transferred to an everlasting original. The passage therefore does not by itself show that each new original volition is externally donated. But an eternal bearer does not cure every regress. The reported *Darʾ* 016 passage distinguishes distinct accomplished effects from an agency whose very capacity never becomes actual without another unactualized completion, or one act whose sufficient conditions are endlessly deferred. Its created-command example targets that latter absence of an actual originating basis. Successive intrinsic acts can specify different occasions; perpetual deferral of the completion of this same act cannot be defended merely by calling its bearer eternal. [WISE-PARTICULAR]

The corresponding account of ends distinguishes successful succession from never obtaining the good. An intrinsically loved end terminates merely instrumental justification; the final-cause discussion at *Shifāʾ* e210 does not revoke the efficient-causal question about new occurrences. At e211–212, fulfilled goods can be followed by further fulfilled goods, instead of every good awaiting an unattained final event. Nor does e178 require a separately individuated special divine will for every created breath, movement or letter: general creative willing can constitute active creaturely natures, motives and circumstances, with guidance supplying support and removing impediments. That productive organization cannot be discarded while a generic standing will is retained as the whole explanation of each event. The passage supplies neither a full individuation theory of divine volitions nor an unrestricted solution to a divine meta-volition problem. Its universal-source reply at e207 also invokes the theological premise that no other creator exists; that part is not an independent proof of the premise. [WISE-PARTICULAR]

<a id="second250-shifa-conditions-and-manifestation"></a>

The *Shifāʾ* records distinguish several kinds of sufficiency within this positive account. E104 separates antecedent enablement, including organs, available means and access, from act-concurrent complete capacity; only the latter entails the occurrence. E189 distinguishes abolishing a cause's power, blocking its manifestation while that power persists, and allowing its effect. E305 then distinguishes originating the receptive subject, preparing it and continually sustaining it. E306 expressly allows both a locally sufficient cause and a contributor requiring an additional factor. Thus an intrinsic disposition can be real without independent existence, unmasked manifestation or every external requisite. These distinctions prevent an inference from generic power to actual effect while preserving genuine gifted efficacy. [S250B-050, lines 10–12](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/3e14cde13e7ff0f24b55aa8cf0fd7a100f8ef4392f99068dabecfd7b7cba8099/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L10-L12) [S250B-050, lines 178–180](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/3e14cde13e7ff0f24b55aa8cf0fd7a100f8ef4392f99068dabecfd7b7cba8099/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L178-L180) [S250B-106, lines 28–36](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/82d4e66a511d406b215089c4f8e3598294aa1626cfd627b38bcb37fe5f92eb6d/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L28-L36) [S250B-107, lines 113–114](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L113-L114) [S250B-163, lines 49–51](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/c1216e888c0d51fcd7fece9ec35b71090e9462a24d8207a53d7903a7b0d4c27f/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L49-L51) [S250B-189, lines 39–43](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/de2952b7550d7007126e5c6ccb5c1621d54dbc008c491bd1ab3f7a36b9c2b0cc/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L39-L43)

The reply to al-Rāzī's self-completion dilemma has positive content beyond denying dependence. A good whose fitting time has not arrived is not a perfection culpably missing now; realizing a loved end in its fitting manner and time can be an excellence. Intrinsic wisdom is not a foreign donor. E219–221 adds actual, varied wise kingship and argues that even good intention with limited power may be more praiseworthy than powerful purposeless action. This rules out reducing perfection to unused capacity or sheer quantity of effects. The dependency reply at e220 says all the conditions of kingship come from the original source; that is a substantive coherence defense of comprehensive creatorhood, not an independent derivation of that very universal provision. [S250B-136, lines 9–15](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/9b6d1495d1a7f2eda92d71a6df0d6570af283d1f9851abf58b0165844a1709e2/NOTES.md#L9-L15) [S250B-107, lines 8–24](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L8-L24) [S250B-163, lines 34–40](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/c1216e888c0d51fcd7fece9ec35b71090e9462a24d8207a53d7903a7b0d4c27f/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L34-L40) [S250B-065, lines 23–27](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/53ae95d84dbda238beb5e91401ec19f9217dcaf852d5a614920d3605b816a925/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L23-L27)

Two defenses of mediation also remain separate. Some ends constitutively require their relations or conditions, so deleting those conditions changes the intended end. Where direct attainment is possible, the intervening beings and history may realize additional goods. Neither reply makes every observed causal connection metaphysically necessary. Neither establishes that an independently original peer is possible or required. They do show why a matching coarse endpoint does not establish an equally fitting substitute for the entire mediated undertaking. [S250B-107, lines 13–14](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L13-L14) [S250B-107, lines 122–122](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L122-L122) [S250B-093, lines 55–59](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/7324a2b7f73e5cfd4403138b1691b56a000deb10ecfa998ee36698cfa13db1af/FINAL_SHIFA_ADDENDUM.md#L55-L59)

**Productive explanation and the question left over.** O’Connor’s 2013 comparison belongs on the positive side of actual productive provision: a nonnecessitating source remains a real producer, not a description, a brute contingent original or an entirely derivative field. Four questions nevertheless differ: what productively supplies the actual received reality; what makes the original intrinsically adequate for its own existence; why any contingent creation exists; and why this entire history occurs rather than another. The chapter openly rejects a strongly contrastive PSR in favour of causal explanation and a broader principle allowing a nonvacuous explanation of why some contingent truths lack explanation. It should not be represented as retaining the former standard while secretly exempting free choice. Necessary reasons may remain present while their actual explanatory relation to an act is contingent. That distinction does not itself provide a necessitating answer to the history contrast. [COMPLETE-EXPLANATION-2013]

This disagreement does not directly defeat Completion in §3. Under the intended interpretation, an intrinsically instantiated, actually operative or contributing, unreceived power relevant to the received target can supply its required resource. A dormant ability cannot. Nonreceipt of the bearer does not by itself establish nonreceipt of every intrinsic resource: support transport runs from whole-bearer receipt to resource receipt, not conversely. Modal persistence likewise does not remove a derivative bearer from the received field. The chapter supplies no unrestricted proof of Realisation, receipt representation, same-respect transport or every relevance instance. Its productive agreement is conditional but substantive, while disagreement over exhaustive contrastive adequacy concerns a stronger proposition. [COMPLETE-EXPLANATION-2013]

The optional-creation limit is especially important. If the necessary source could have produced nothing contingent, explaining these concrete objects does not also answer why there is **anything contingent at all**. Requiring some creation necessarily would address a different question without making each object, act or complete history necessary. Similarly, actual productive powers and an independently warranted account of their operation distinguish explained indeterminacy from a brute occurrence; merely assigning a nature the label “indeterministic,” or a terminus the label “brute,” supplies neither that warrant nor a nonvacuous explanation of its explanatory limits. Local conditional accounts can leave total existential provision open, but local conditionality alone does not refute a rival’s claim that the whole distributive account is complete. The positive whole-field rationale retains the additional adequacy judgment defended in §§2–5. [COMPLETE-EXPLANATION-2013]

These distinctions preserve the affirmative account of informed purposive activity and intrinsic conditional succession without pretending to exhibit every particular ground of the actual divine history. Ignorance of that detail proves neither its absence nor one proposed determination. The remaining comparison must establish the actual productive nature or relevant possibility, its relation to this exercise, and its explanatory stopping rule. It cannot be settled by redescribing a selected outcome, by requiring every explanation to entail its effect as a definition, or by treating the original as externally completed whenever its own acts have conditions. The source return’s Arabic electronic coordinates, reported voices and transcription limits are inherited; no new primary collation is claimed. The O’Connor report records the complete argument and notes 1–21 on printed pp. 22–43, not unavailable bibliography pp. 44–45, and its scientific analogy is not a new verification of quantum theory or divine agency. [WISE-PARTICULAR] [COMPLETE-EXPLANATION-2013] [COMPLETE-EXPLANATION-MODAL]

**Reason-basing and a complete determining basis.** A further comparison fixes the target as this actual choice of $A$ on reasons $S$, denoted $D$, rather than the agent’s existence, standing capacity or produced effect. In Pruss’s preferred account, $q_S$ concerns making a choice while appreciating $S$; it does not already specify that $A$ is chosen or that $S$ is the operative basis. In the divine application $q_S$ is necessary while $D$ is contingent. Appreciation, operative basing, particular willing and completed production are explanatory distinctions, not four successive divine psychological episodes; basing and willing may be aspects of one act. Consequently, efficacy of the complete actual willing does not make $q_S$ that complete willing or establish that appreciation alone determines it. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON]

Pruss’s positive reply concerns genuine reasons, not an outcome renamed as its own reason. $S$ favours $A$, while other appreciated reasons $T$ favour $B$; had $B$ been chosen, $T$ would have been operative although $S$ remained appreciated. Unused considerations need not be included in the explanation merely because they are true. Crucially, §4.1.1.6 explicitly asks why the agent acted on the operative reason and proposes appreciation of that reason as the explanation again. The answer is nonnecessitating, not an omission of the question. His preferred S/T account must be assessed before his separate same-circumstances fallback. Likewise, the noncontrastive PSR fallback does not erase the preferred account’s contrastive ambition: explaining a proposition equivalent to $P\land\neg Q$ is not automatically explaining why $P$ rather than $Q$ in the stronger contrast-sensitive sense. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON] [PARTICULAR-BASING-SOURCES]

The inherited Ibn Taymiyyah comparison maintains a stronger requirement. *Majmūʿ* VIII, item 805, L312 explicitly endorses a general complete-determiner principle for possible occurrences; it is not merely an execution rule applied after willing already exists. The particular-specification argument at L341–344 is a reported dialectic, not an unmarked authorial quotation throughout. Its equality premise concerns all relevant respects, not equality on one value score; Pruss’s different option-favouring reasons are not thereby that equal-option case. The complete-basis demand does not require a unique normative optimizer or an external supplier of divine will. *Bayān* V, item 962, L006–007 instead attributes unreceived willing to God. The source’s standing-capacity/complete-efficacy distinction and successive intrinsic acts remain compatible with this demand, while ignorance of a particular wisdom does not establish its absence. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON] [PARTICULAR-BASING-SOURCES]

The quantifiers prevent a false contradiction. Requiring **some complete entailing basis for each actual possible occurrence** does not require **every explanation to entail its explanandum**. Allowing **some nonentailing reason-explanation** does not exclude **some other complete determining basis**. Pruss’s note 11 expressly permits internal determination to be compatible with the freedom of an uncaused agent; it does not assert that this creation is so determined. An incompatibility argument therefore needs an additional premise identifying his $q_S$ with the very complete basis at issue, or establishing a denial of every such basis. The retained passages supply neither. Conversely, their absence does not discharge the stronger complete-determiner demand merely because Pruss’s expressly weaker explanatory standard is met. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON]

There is nevertheless a definite failed identification. Across the same admissible alternatives, necessary $q_S$ and contingent $D$ imply that $q_S$ cannot entail $D$: at an alternative where $D$ fails, $q_S$ still holds. Adding the factive statement that $q_S$ actually explains $D$ can make the enlarged proposition entail $D$, but its logical form does not independently warrant what particularises that explanatory relation. Pruss answers that question using $q_S$ again under a nonnecessitating relation. This is not a formal contradiction or by itself a proof of vicious circularity. The precise disagreement concerns the adequacy of that explanation for the fixed purpose, rather than the presence of any reason, agency or producer. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON]

This gives the positive reason-based proposal its stated explanatory credit without converting it into complete particular-basis warrant. It exhibits neither God’s actual particular reason nor concordant original-peer willing, and even successful explanation of a chosen joint plan would not establish independent whole-work productive provision by each peer. The received reports retain the affirmative informed-agency and Wisdom arguments and quarantine suspect electronic passages rather than silently emending them. Their later contextual reading of the retained author-hosted Pruss chapter’s relevant sections and note 11 is distinct from the earlier predecessor’s indexed-only access recorded below. Neither historical reading report is fresh primary authentication here. [PARTICULAR-BASING-COMPARISON] [PARTICULAR-BASING-SOURCES]

**Direct purposive exercise and the intrinsic-act comparison.** The positive agency case must face a stronger rival than blind production. In O’Connor's 2009 account, reasons structure propensities and an agent produces an intention with purposive content. Bearer, capacity, motivation and productive relation are substantive commitments, motivated by a powers framework and an abductive case from agency. They distinguish production from merely recording a selected outcome. The chapter expressly does not establish actual human instantiation, and its defeasible intelligibility claim allows unresolved metaphysical impossibility. An irreducible creaturely capacity can still be generated and sustained; immediate production of an intention does not establish original nonreceipt, necessary existence, sovereignty or Wisdom. [agent-power-comparison]

The account also answers objections that should not be erased in compression. Causation need not create a second event called “the causing,” indefinitely generating further causes; rejecting that reification does not answer the separate grounding question about this exercise and timing. Event-only or uniform-power restrictions need independent support. Matching observed frequencies does not identify causal structures, and statistical constraints do not show that something other than the agent produces the token choice. The replies to redundancy and luck therefore block cheap impossibility arguments without establishing the posited power. Phenomenology and responsibility beliefs do not uniquely settle its metaphysics. Suggested timing and purposive-content discriminators remain tentative, with their relation to the chapter's stated probabilities needing a sharper specification. Other control objections noted by the chapter are not thereby resolved. These are actual replies and remaining evidential limits, not a missing explanation redescribed as a completed test. [agent-power-comparison]

The original-scope proposal in O’Connor's 1999 *Simplicity and Creation* is different again. His initial model has the agent produce a reason-bearing intrinsic intention that produces creation. His modification for a simplicity theorist removes that executive intermediary: the agent directly produces an order for an apprehended purpose, with variation in the agent–creation relation while the intrinsic nature is invariant. This challenges a claimed necessity of a distinct intrinsic executive state without adopting simplicity or preserving the disputed state under another name. Cross-world intrinsic invariance is not temporal inactivity. Actual personal exercise and rational purpose remain, so the informed-versus-blind comparison alone cannot decide between these two purposive accounts. [simplicity-comparison]

The middleman objection has precise force. If an otherwise unexplained intention is immediately produced by an agent, inserting it does not explain the selection merely because it is inside the agent. Demanding another prior intention just to authenticate that production repeats the problem. But parity between direct agent-to-intention and agent-to-world production within an indeterministic model does not establish parity with **adequately grounded intrinsic willing**. The stronger source account permits relevant internally originated conditions and fulfilled succession, rather than keeping the complete particular basis indifferent. Those conditions still need positive warrant; adding the words “adequately grounded” would be as insufficient as naming a basic exercise. The distinction between completed successive acts and endlessly deferred completion of this very act, already established above, blocks a false dilemma without displaying a uniquely determined whole history. [simplicity-comparison]

The practical discriminator is basing. A useful effect can fit a reason without being produced **for** that reason. Ownership answers whose exercise it is; knowledge identifies the apprehended good; neither automatically establishes which consideration guides this particular production. A distinct intrinsic commitment is one proposed realization of that relation, while a primitive or otherwise grounded reason-directed exercise is another. The rival explicitly claims genuine direction, so replacing it with accidental output conformity would beg the question. Equally, that claim needs enough positive content to do its explanatory work. The source's power/knowledge/actual-willing distinction and informed-efficacy comparison provide affirmative reasons for practical commitment, but the familiar bodily need for executive intentions is not a universal argument about divine realization. [simplicity-comparison]

The proposal's remaining limits matter. Agent causation is assumed, not proved anew; the integration of rich cognitive and practical reasons with simplicity is unresolved, not reduced to a featureless scalar. Necessary creation of **something**, toward which the paper inclines, would not determine this order or establish perpetual fulfilled activity. Complete self-knowledge must also be integrated: importing the actual effect into factive knowledge cannot select that effect, but differing known truths do not by themselves prove differing intrinsic mental states. None of these unresolved interfaces is a demonstrated contradiction. The source's positive intrinsic-activity account and the rival's direct-purpose account therefore differ over realization and adequate particular determination, not over whether knowledge, agency or purpose has any explanatory value. [simplicity-comparison]

**Positive creative reasons are not yet a complete tie.** O’Connor's 2008 *Theism and the Scope of Contingency* contributes a richer original-scope account of fitting ends: beneficent communication, qualitative excellence and diversity of worthwhile forms, without appeal to fatigue, scarcity or a need to acquire essential perfection from recipients. Its preferred nonaggregative direction responds to transfinite difficulties in an earlier infinite-total argument. It can motivate breadth across irreducible kinds and thresholds of worthiness without treating endless duplication as the governing good. Neither rejecting sheer quantity nor causal separation of created regions makes every better instance, relation between instances or mode of productive organization irrelevant. Its application to evil is not a completed theodicy. [creation-scope-comparison]

A simple comparison shows why the structural conditions are not a sufficient equal-best criterion. In a conditional one-kind representation, let $c>\tau$ and, for $n\geq0$, put $a_n=c+n+1$ and $b_n=c+2(n+1)$. Both arrays exceed threshold $\tau$ and are unbounded, but the specified kind-preserving index matching gives $b_n>a_n$ throughout. If both arrays are jointly feasible and strict matched improvement is normatively decisive, the first meets the structural conditions yet is inferior. More generally, closure under jointly realisable strict memberwise improvements preserving those conditions excludes a maximal array under that norm. Joint feasibility, the normative significance of the matching and the improvement rule are additional premises: unbounded individual possibilities alone prove none of them. This is a limitation of a proposed sufficiency claim, not a mathematical certification of creatable universes, a numerical theory of goodness or a refutation of the chapter's explicitly incomplete proposal. [creation-scope-comparison]

The source's final direction goes from worthiness to conformity with the constraints, rather than proving their sufficiency. Its p. 146 note 15 expressly leaves further reasons capable of settling one array open. Repairs could restrict justified global comparisons, establish a genuine feasibility barrier, or add independently warranted practical goods. They may yield a unique optimum, several permissible options or incomparability; the present criteria decide none of these. A complete output description is not a complete normative context. Feasible and jointly realizable options, individual identity, intrinsic and relational goods, the authority of thresholds and comparisons, suitable agent-relative or occasion-sensitive reasons, prior intrinsic acts and actual operative basing all require their appropriate account. This does not demand that a finite investigator enumerate the whole divine history. Ignorance of those reasons proves neither a real tie nor a unique optimum. [creation-scope-comparison]

The option-space qualifications cannot be suppressed. Qualitative alternatives are not merely renamed identical worlds. A framework denying antecedently available thisness for an uncreated individual cannot simply invoke prior attachment to that individual as its selector. A framework evaluating indeterministic future types concerns what determinate choice-informing truths exist; it is not straightforwardly a denial of omniscience, but cannot be transported without argument to exhaustive foreknowledge of one realized history. Conversely, a factive knowledge label supplies no productive reason on its own. Determination by an original's own wise nature need not be foreign compulsion, so the chapter is no proof of categorical divine libertarianism. Its generic ends could accompany a defended noncontrastive account, or further intrinsic grounds could settle the act. Neither combination is established merely by the positive ends. A plurality of possible complete creations is not successive acts within one history, and one creation-type need not be one act. A perfect-being premise of universal provision is not independently proved by its conditional applications. [creation-scope-comparison]

These comparisons sharpen, rather than replace, the affirmative treatment. The original's actual informed efficacy, intrinsic willing and fulfilled succession retain their positive grounds. The rival earns the explanatory credit of a genuine power and purpose while contesting the stronger differentiating-basis requirement. A particular useful outcome, an internal intermediary, a cofinal value profile or a general stopping principle cannot settle that dispute by itself. Section 4.5 identifies the further warrant a principled explanatory boundary needs; the preceding Pruss comparison keeps appreciation, actual basing and a complete determining basis distinct. No claim here exhibits the actual complete divine history, independently authenticates primary sources, or certifies the possibility of either rival ontology. [agent-power-comparison] [simplicity-comparison] [creation-scope-comparison]

**Inherited sources and access.** The six named source reports, not a fresh literature search, support this continuation. They report full readings of O’Connor's [“Agent-Causal Power”][agency-primary-2009] (2009, pp. 189–214, DOI 10.1093/oso/9780199558933.003.0007), [“Theism and the Scope of Contingency”][agency-primary-2008] (2008, pp. 134–149, DOI 10.1093/oso/9780199542659.003.0006), and [“Simplicity and Creation”][agency-primary-1999] (1999, pp. 405–412, DOI 10.5840/faithphil199916339), with their stated notes and localized visual checks. The 1999 witness had already been read elsewhere in the programme. Hiddleston, Clarke, Pereboom and the 2008 chapter's interlocutors are not independently adjudicated here; the reported failed Hiddleston acquisition supplies no text-reading credit. [agent-power-comparison] [simplicity-comparison] [creation-scope-comparison]

The stopping and parity reports inherit O’Connor's [*Could There Be a Complete Explanation of Everything?*][agency-primary-2013], printed pp. 22–43 and notes 1–21, not its unavailable bibliography pp. 44–45. The parity report records Della Rocca's [“PSR”][agency-primary-parity] (2010, 13 pages and notes 1–15) through the author's public text upload, without acquiring or fully visually collating the published PDF. The autonomy report makes a targeted return to the already-read [*Metaphysical Rationalism*][agency-primary-autonomy] (2016, pp. 379–418), especially the distinctions at printed pp. 387, 393 and 395, rather than a new independent reading of that work. These inherited primary locators are not fresh access claims. The Arabic comparisons retain their exact limited electronic coordinates, speaker distinctions and damaged-text exclusions; none is fresh collation, complete-work authentication or an attribution of the modern authors' entire explanatory packages to Ibn Taymiyyah. [stopping-asymmetry] [explicability-parity] [principled-boundary]

The remaining modal question is more exact than either slogan “free choice” or “necessary nature.” Holding the source's entire necessary nature fixed, can distinct particular wise acts occur? If a unique best act and a necessarily sufficient practical policy are added, the act may be determined. If the relevant practical reasons permit several fitting determinations, a further account of particular willing is needed. Merely drawing two worlds does not establish their metaphysical possibility; merely recognizing intrinsic cognition and wisdom does not already settle that they contain the same act. The actual-effects proposition remains valid on either account at its own conditional scope.

### 12.10 Wisdom, fitting ends and practical integrity

Instrumental competence, practical wisdom and moral perfection are different claims. A highly effective optimizer can achieve an unfitting end. Practical wisdom concerns the apprehended fittingness of ends and means, their appropriate relations and occasions, and action through that apprehension. Moral perfection additionally concerns the relevant goods and harms of others and the absence of disordered practical orientation. A conclusion about one of these cannot be secured by changing the sense of “best” midway through the argument.

The strongest affirmative route is therefore more substantial than “the source knows every fact.” Suppose that genuine reasons favor the fitting alternative; that the source apprehends them with their proper weight and scope; that its practical orientation responds appropriately to those reasons; and that no ignorance, need, appetite or disorder defeats that response. Then knowingly choosing a worse alternative without an adequate overriding reason is excluded. The conclusion follows from knowledge together with practical integrity. The source study reads the Knowledge-to-Wisdom passage of *al-Nubuwwāt* in precisely this practical setting: the argument invokes fitting action, preference and the defects responsible for contrary action. It is an authorial positive argument, not merely a report of an opponent or proof of universal philosophical agreement. [*Al-Nubuwwāt*, electronic division 003][kg-nubuwwat]

The practical-integrity premise has its own positive rationale. Apprehension that can govern action through a fitting end is an integrated excellence beyond mere co-location of representation and efficacy. An informed will that discriminates what is worthy of pursuit possesses a positive qualification absent from wholly indifferent or knowingly perverse willing. The original-giver account applies to this integrated excellence when its eligibility is defended. The pure-perfection argument also compares intrinsically wise self-direction with arbitrary or disordered exercise. *Al-Akmaliyya* distinguishes subjection to a superior commander from the source's own wise commitment and connects the latter with mercy and beneficence. [*Majmūʿ*, VI, 129–130][kg-mf6] These are reasons for affirming practical integrity; defining a “perfect agent” as one that has it would not supply those reasons.

Creature-directed goodness requires an equally explicit scope. Dependent subjects have real goods and are vulnerable to real harms. An original that understands and intentionally governs their conditions has those goods within the relevant practical field. Freedom from need need not mean indifference to others: an intrinsic appreciation of worthwhile action is different from bargaining for a missing essential perfection. Knowledgeable beneficence can thus be an eligible original excellence, rather than compensation for a deficiency. The original's relation to the subjects, their genuine goods and the relevant practical orientation together support the affirmative extension.

A stronger rival challenges the connection between apprehended value and motivation. It grants complete theoretical information and freedom from ordinary need but posits indifference or a preference for harm. Hume's argument that reason by itself does not motivate supplies a useful formulation of this challenge; it does not establish that the complete original satisfies the rival's proposed motivational profile. [Hume, *Treatise*, II.iii.3][kg-hume-motivation] Ordinary weakness, appetite or ignorance is also not a counterexample to a source already granted perfect practical integrity. The substantive issue is whether objective fittingness and the defended original perfection justify the source's orientation towards it. Removing a cruel appetite while retaining an intrinsic love of good action must be explained through that value distinction, not through a rule excluding every motive on one side and allowing every motive on the other.

The affirmative appraisal does not explain every permission of harm merely by naming a hidden purpose. Willing that an event occur, approving it as an end and permitting it within a wider action are different relations. A permissible means may be unwelcome in itself. Those distinctions can make a wise account coherent, but applying them to a particular harmful occurrence requires its relevant reasons and scope. The source study's historical distinction between cosmic willing and approval is retained as such; no new empirical explanation of an anatomical feature, suffering or an actual history is established here. Ancient examples illustrate the philosophical argument and are not fresh biological evidence.

<a id="second250-shifa-practical-and-final-ends"></a>

The received *Shifāʾ* reading makes the positive practical account concrete. Decree includes learning, effort and the means to an end; it does not excuse continuing wrongdoing. The four combinations of occurrence and normative approval prevent inferring love from occurrence or inability from an unfulfilled command. Antecedent access and capacity matter to accountability, while character and chosen acts can reinforce or damage later receptivity. The text distinguishes causal agency from culpability in coercion, sleep, intoxication and inadvertence, rather than making every unaccountable event causally idle. Its testing argument also distinguishes prior knowledge from the actual deeds for which praise and blame are assigned. These are historically reported theological and legal distinctions, not present clinical or legal advice. [S250B-019, lines 19–20](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/119dd89e918ed573921ed8cd8a5a0881808955a0ae37845765a9a27c85c474be/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L19-L20) [S250B-019, lines 39–41](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/119dd89e918ed573921ed8cd8a5a0881808955a0ae37845765a9a27c85c474be/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L39-L41) [S250B-019, lines 50–51](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/119dd89e918ed573921ed8cd8a5a0881808955a0ae37845765a9a27c85c474be/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L50-L51) [S250B-050, lines 94–96](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/3e14cde13e7ff0f24b55aa8cf0fd7a100f8ef4392f99068dabecfd7b7cba8099/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L94-L96) [S250B-050, lines 124–126](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/3e14cde13e7ff0f24b55aa8cf0fd7a100f8ef4392f99068dabecfd7b7cba8099/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L124-L126) [S250B-107, lines 49–50](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L49-L50) [S250B-106, lines 50–58](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/82d4e66a511d406b215089c4f8e3598294aa1626cfd627b38bcb37fe5f92eb6d/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L50-L58)

Wisdom does not reduce to bare power or lucky benefit. E200–201 explicitly argues that bare power and willing cannot discriminate truthful revelation from a liar's apparent success, and that known or possible opposites do not explain why one judgement is best. Intentional wise character supplies the further explanatory claim. The extended prayer and repentance accounts similarly present embodied, repeated practices as genuinely formative means to knowledge, love, gratitude and correction, not merely arbitrary trials. Yet defeating one proof-text objection does not complete a theodicy: at e163 the source expressly limits its immediate task, and at e276 the question of created initial receptivity reaches an acknowledged limit. Positive pains and destructive causes remain real within its nuanced privation account. Unknown wider wisdom is not an independently displayed explanation of each sufferer's case. The final fitra argument is a positive account of directed development, not articulate newborn theology or an autonomous innate power. It distinguishes original sound orientation from later acquired distortion, worldly legal classification from inward and ultimate standing, and reception from instruction alone. E300–305 joins awareness, maturation, absence of impediments, possible reinforcing help and the source's origination, preparation and continued aid. The move from truth-seeking to determinate theology additionally uses the source's claims about what is true and perfect. E306–307 then combines termination of instrumental ends, a real determinate object, perfection and common innate orientation to argue for one ultimate beloved. Being determinate or noninstrumental alone does not entail being the only intrinsic good; undivided ultimate worship and a single shared final object require the stronger exclusivity and fitra premises. [S250B-107, lines 92–114](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/8319570085141203223c558eb4f1ec7b614eec8a5fe7ca9c47d9dd9508b06994/CONTINUOUS_NOTES.md#L92-L114) [S250B-129, lines 56–62](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/95fb06fda8b6849449e5c6027cc8ea466c49e6795ca603526c6b349cdd93634f/SHIFA_SELECTED_CONTROL.md#L56-L62) [S250B-189, lines 39–43](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/de2952b7550d7007126e5c6ccb5c1621d54dbc008c491bd1ab3f7a36b9c2b0cc/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L39-L43) [S250B-189, lines 59–63](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/de2952b7550d7007126e5c6ccb5c1621d54dbc008c491bd1ab3f7a36b9c2b0cc/SOURCE_APPRAISAL.md#L59-L63)

The substantial punishment-duration discussion must keep its actual argumentative voice. E254 first introduces the finite-remedial case as a represented view; the subsequent favorable reasoning and e264 first-person appraisal make pure authorial detachment untenable. E264 also expressly limits what the inquiry has reached and defers what happens thereafter to divine will. The record therefore preserves favorable, inquiry-bounded argument rather than an unqualified final universalist dogma. It also preserves the criticized alternatives, the strong incorrigibility objection, the weakened supporting chain identified at e260 and the tension with earlier claims about observers' benefit. These are source arguments about wisdom and mercy, not freshly authenticated traditions or a complete independently established outcome.
