#### Conceptual distinction, co-necessitation and dependence

The composition argument can be reconstructed without treating every use of “part” or “dependence” as interchangeable. The predecessor first contrasts separable pieces assembled into a whole with conceptually distinguishable attributes of one bearer. It then distinguishes causal need for an external donor from necessary co-occurrence of a bearer and an intrinsic attribute. If an argument starts with conceptual distinction and concludes external assembly or causal dependence solely by switching senses, it equivocates. The conclusion requires a warranted bridge, not the shared word. The limited counterinterpretation in §10.16 already demonstrates that sharing a predicate and having differentiating descriptions need not introduce proper constituents.

That criticism does not settle every argument from real composition. A theory can claim an asymmetric grounding dependence among inseparable realities. Its premise need not be spatial assembly or possible disassembly. Necessary co-occurrence does not by itself refute such a relation: take two propositions both true throughout a model and add an asymmetric explanatory relation from one to the other. Their modal equivalence remains while the stipulated explanatory direction differs. This thin interpretation does not validate a developed grounding theory; it shows why co-necessitation alone cannot erase that theory's extra premise. The actual dispute must concern whether the alleged relation applies and whether it conflicts with original independence.

The second source move rejects a bare extramental essence stripped of every qualification. Its positive alternative is one actually qualified bearer, with the mind distinguishing attributes for analysis. The source calls the distinction *iʿtibārī*, or conceptual, while affirming real attributes. The defensible consequence here is that conceptual distinguishability does not imply separable entities. It must not be silently strengthened to the claim that all attribute reality is merely invented by a mind, or that every true predicate has the same meaning. The source's linguistic appeal to qualified uses of “essence” can illustrate its conception; grammar alone does not establish the full ontology. Its broad claim about opponents conceding the impossibility of an attribute-less substance also requires the actual relevant sources before being used as a historical consensus premise. [Sound Reason, §6.3][pf-sound-reason]

Finally the account proposes *talāzum*: intrinsic essential attributes belong necessarily with the qualified source. On its pure-perfection argument, the eligible excellence does not await a foreign donor and is not contingently absent from an otherwise complete original. This is a substantive positive ground for intrinsic qualification. The standing-Knowledge argument in §12.6 shows the additional nature-to-attribute premise explicitly. Mere necessary co-occurrence does not establish that premise's warrant, and mere possible absence would not by logic alone imply eventual acquisition from an external donor. The perfection and original-adequacy premises do that work. The resulting position affirms real intrinsic perfection, refuses to turn conceptual plurality into an automatic debt to external parts, and preserves the different status of particular voluntary acts. Its mode of intrinsic qualification remains under the same *bilā kayf* limit as its other attribute claims.

These arguments complement the epistemology of sound cognition without becoming an automatic warrant for every belief formed within the tradition. Meaningful predication, a justified attribute, an actual speech act, faithful transmission, source authority and recipient uptake still have distinct conditions. The affirmative source account can provide a richer basis for truth-directed cognition when those conditions are established. The restoration and correction models cannot supply them merely by producing the expected response. [*Recognition, Warrant, Defeat and Restoration*, §§3 and 9](../epistemology/recognition-warrant-and-restoration.md) [*Objective Normativity and Corrective Cognition*, §7](objective-normativity-and-corrective-cognition.md#7-truth-calibrated-revision-on-a-finite-network)


<a id="f250-a-qualified-perfection"></a>

#### The perfection argument's eligible subjects and predicates

The *Ṣafadiyya* passages provide positive reasons for intrinsic perfection, not only warnings against overextension. S001L132–135 and S002L330–337 argue from a perfection possible for existence and free of defect: it would be unfitting for the inferior dependent to possess such excellence while its superior independent source could not; the giver of a creature's eligible excellence has the stronger claim to it; and that source cannot acquire its original perfection from its own product or from another ultimate giver without losing the independence at issue. The complete intrinsic ground is then held to entail the qualification permanently. The immediately following distinction accepts intrinsic necessitation for necessary attributes while rejecting its transport to eternally necessitated creatures. These are the substantive eligibility, priority and independence premises of the affirmative ascent, not consequences of generic causation alone. [F250-A067-101-117] [F250-A067-445-459] [F250-A062-61-88] [F250-A145-38-63]

The qualification is decisive. S002L507 expressly denies that creating a colour, taste or motion in something else makes that quality an intrinsic divine attribute. Attributive subsistence, ownership and special association are different relations: knowledge or speech is not related to the bearer in the way a house, servant or specially designated creature is. Likewise an object of love or imitation can function as an end without efficiently making the lover's capacity or act. A represented end may guide action before the object exists externally. The productive source, receptive condition, final end and evidence of an attribute therefore cannot be substituted inside one undifferentiated transfer rule. [F250-A067-507-527] [F250-A067-697-710] [F250-A000-31-73]

The final discussion makes the filter threefold. Knowledge, mercy and wisdom can commend a creature while retaining meaningful common predication. Divine exclusives, including divinity and the domination or pride at issue in that passage, are not excellences to be assumed by a creature. Conversely, servanthood, dependence, humility and petition can be creaturely excellences precisely in relation to an independent Lord, and cannot characterize that Lord as needful. The shared name thus does not erase the bearer-relative conditions of excellence. Neither “transfer every creaturely perfection” nor “no meaningful common predication” represents the source's resolution. Its report of opposing views on divine-name assimilation, including al-Ghazālī, remains a historically attributed polemic; the modern editor's qualifications at printed 577 are a separate voice, not independent authentication of all sides. [F250-A067-854-863] [F250-A091-23-54] [F250-A030-49-64]

The same work separates knowing a good, loving it, obtaining it and enjoying it. Cognition can concern something painful; beneficial understanding without the required practice is not sufficient for the good outcome. Its account of human fulfilment therefore joins cognitive, voluntary and affective realization rather than collapsing them into one property. This supplies a useful control on the present theory: a necessary condition, an enabling faculty and a sufficient productive explanation are not interchangeable. Nor does an inferential middle term become a constituent or intermediary in its object's existence merely because a particular knower needed it to learn the truth. The affirmative epistemic account permits immediate, inferential and hearer-relative routes; it does not impose one lengthy proof on every person. [F250-A067-754-760] [F250-A067-784-795] [F250-A067-812-817] [F250-A091-7-36] [F250-A169-57-91]

<a id="foundation250-b-responsive-efficacy"></a>

**Qualified intrinsic reality and real response.** The complete received *al-Ṣawāʿiq* reports supply a fuller positive account behind these distinctions. Face 61 distinguishes a separable external thing from a cognitively distinguishable attribute, and need for an outside producer from inseparable inherence in a bearer. The necessary reality is the concrete essence qualified by life, knowledge, power and will, not a bare substrate subsequently equipped by donors. The four levels of the “highest exemplar” then distinguish perfection in that reality, its cognition in creatures, its verbal expression, and worship directed to its bearer. Neither a human conception nor its expression becomes the divine subject. This is an affirmative account of qualified subsistence, not a general elimination of every dependence relation one might propose within an ontology. [F250B022, faces 61 and 79][F250B022] [F250B076, §§2–3][F250B076]

Faces 131–133 distinguish what follows from a predicate as such, what follows from its divine bearer, and what follows from its created bearer. Knowledge concerns known things; the further claims of eternal comprehensive knowledge and of limited acquired cognition belong to their respective modes. Divine guidance and the creature's resulting acceptance are genuinely different acts. Creating is not identical with its product. Face 234 consequently rejects both reducing divine predication to creaturely modes and reducing creaturely life, knowledge and power to mere metaphor. Shared intelligible content permits unequal realization; graded predication is treated as a species of common-meaning predication, not pure homonymy. Real creaturely efficacy belongs within the source account rather than being an embarrassment to remove. [F250B022, faces 131–133 and 234][F250B022] [F250B035, act/product and composition discussions][F250B035] [F250B076, §§4 and 6][F250B076]

The response-to-influence argument is particularly important. Complete self-knowledge, self-love and self-praise do not await creaturely approval to supply a missing constitutive perfection. Yet approval of repentance, anger at wrongdoing, hearing, seeing and answering prayer are defended as real. The relevant creaturely occasions belong within the divine creative order; they are not independent external suppliers of deity. The sixth collection similarly answers the acquisition dilemma by emphasizing that God originates the newly beloved worship, while allowing a genuine relation to its occurrence. Alternative theories offered to an opponent about eternal attributes and renewed relations are dialectical parity replies, not all simultaneously adopted descriptions. The coherence defense is strong once comprehensive wise sourcehood is granted; it does not independently prove that scope merely by invoking it. [F250B022, face 200][F250B022] [F250B076, §5][F250B076] [F250B131] [F250B185, E061–072][F250B185]

Its temporal and modal controls are equally positive. Complete decisive willing with complete power entails the fitting act; mere available enjoyment does not supply decisive willing, and failure to create a particular enjoyable thing need not deprive God. Forgiveness after wrong has a prerequisite; successive goods cannot all occur together; time, measure and circumstances can belong to what is loved. The final theodicy reply 14 nevertheless makes a strong expressive claim: divine acts issue from prior complete attributes, and the names imply appropriate manifested effects rather than remaining idle labels. Together these passages support necessarily efficacious perfection with wise particularization. They establish neither every token product's eternal simultaneous actuality nor a complete semantics proving that every token could have been otherwise. A weak fixed-bearer model omitting expressive activity is not a countermodel to this fuller account. [F250B022, face 200 and final reply 14][F250B022] [F250B076, §§5–7][F250B076] [F250B108]

The theodicy comparison also preserves rival premises. The notes distinguish naturalizing interpretations, purpose-denying voluntarism and accounts denying divine production of human evil, including different views of foreknowledge. The author's affirmative synthesis retains natural powers, genuine finite agency, moral differences, wise ends and comprehensive divine willing together. It is not the bare claim that ownership licenses anything. General warrant for wisdom need not await each particular explanation, but the analogy with a trusted expert needs its own perfect-expert premise. The reported Iblis dialogue is explicitly unauthenticated or constructed argument, not certified divine speech. Historical cosmography, optics, weather and biological examples remain historical explanatory claims, and the source's distinctness-to-spatial-separateness arguments require additional premises beyond generic independence. No modern scientific or interschool verdict is supplied by this integration. [F250B022, faces 147, 200 and 241–242][F250B022] [F250B029] [F250B076]

<a id="r132s-structural-centers"></a>

### 12.15 Structural centers and first-person ownership

The centered knowledge construction in §12.1 specifies an interpretation of first-person content. A different question is whether a neutral structure alone identifies such a center. For a finite declared episode reduct $`S`$ with automorphism group $`G`$, a candidate-center set $`D`$ is invariant exactly when it is a union of $`G`$-orbits. If it is invariant and contains $`x`$, it contains every $`gx`$; conversely a union of whole orbits is preserved by every group element. An invariant singleton must consequently be a fixed point. A transitive action on at least two candidate hosts permits no invariant singleton. [R359-AJ]

This is a structural selection result. A unique fixed controller or a distinguished `self` token need not possess first-person understanding. Adding a center marker can create a singleton orbit by changing the reduct; its de se interpretation still requires warrant. Invariance of finite target sets, implicit determination in a model class and formula-definability in a specified logic are separate questions. The orbit fact cannot by itself supply the stronger logical result, still less a theory of consciousness.

The declared reduct must include every neutral observation, intervention, episode, history and source coordinate used by the proposed inference, or explicitly delimit the omitted coordinates. A token-responsive reflexive controller and a genuine subject can be indistinguishable under a thinner observation without being indistinguishable under every richer semantic or causal description. Likewise, uptake, selection and execution can be co-located in one structural bearer without establishing that bearer as their intentional owner. An episode center also does not establish a numerically stable subject across episodes: lineage, memory, transitions and ownership stability require their own account. Episode-swap and distributed-realization controls preserve those separate burdens.

The primary report covers 16,384 four-host structures and 262,144 target subsets, with a fixed point in 15,680 structures and transitivity in 32. Its distinct colored-graph procedure reports all 4,096 three-node structures, 5,000 sampled five-node structures and 192,768 target subsets, without a criterion mismatch. The source records this as a different implementation within the same model lineage, not external review. Seven frozen hashes and eight source anchors are likewise historical reported checks. No graph-matching or original programme was executed for this exposition. [R359-AJ]

The source's co-predication of knowing, choosing, willing and speaking can restrict a source-expanded class under the interpretation conditions of §10.18. It is not a neutral deduction from a graph's fixed point. The missing H8 bridge conditions are accordingly a typed account of what the proposed personal classification needs, not proof that intellect alone supplies them. Formal personal and impersonal expansions establish nonentailment only in the admitted formal class; they do not establish equal metaphysical probability or realizability. Consciousness, moral personhood, stable wisdom and speech are stronger targets than a structural center. The positive practical argument can still warrant genuine ownership through its substantive premises, while this orbit calculation prevents structural uniqueness from doing that work by itself.

<a id="r359-bz-disclosure"></a>

### 12.16 A disclosure contract preserves speaker, content and medium

The distinctions among source speech, attributed content and created recitation in §§12.11 and 12.14 can be stated as a guarded disclosure contract. The L study keeps `UTTER`, `AUTHOR`, `ATTR_N` and `RELAY` separately represented. Producing a token, uttering it, relaying it and being the author to whom its content is attributed are different relations. Their coincidence in a warranted case requires an argument from the source and transmission conditions; it is not supplied by the same words appearing in several places. [R359BZ-L]

The study's fourteen-condition disclosure gate is the conjunction of the following registered guards:

```math
\begin{aligned}
G_D={}&\mathrm{MENT}\wedge\mathrm{CAP}\wedge\mathrm{UTTER}
\wedge\mathrm{ATTR}_{N}\wedge\mathrm{EXPR}\wedge\mathrm{RELAY}\\
&\wedge\mathrm{CREATED\_TOK}\wedge\mathrm{FID}_{T}
\wedge\mathrm{SID}\wedge\mathrm{PROV}\wedge\mathrm{VER}\\
&\wedge\mathrm{AUTHZ}\wedge\mathrm{APP}\wedge\mathrm{UNCR}_{N}.
\end{aligned}
```

The subscripts and source/medium types remain part of the contract. `AUTHOR` is a separately represented relation, not a fifteenth conjunct in this enumeration. Any inference relating authorship to utterance, attribution or production must retain the semantic conditions that justify it. A created medium does not by itself make the attributed content a creature's independent authorship, just as creation of a medium does not establish authorship of every assertion it happens to carry. This preserves the positive attribution question without collapsing it into the token's causal production.

In the Boolean specialization where all fourteen guard values vary independently, exactly one of the $`2^{14}=16,384`$ assignments satisfies the whole conjunction. Starting from that assignment, falsifying any one guard gives a deletion witness to its necessity in this specified gate. This proves a fact about the conjunction. It does not authenticate the mental or expressive relation, identify the source, establish faithful transmission, justify authorization, determine the version or make the proposition applicable to a recipient. It also does not establish that every Boolean assignment is a physically or semantically realizable world.

Several failure modes are consequently different. Correctly copied words can have an unestablished source identity. An authentic older version can be inapplicable to the present episode. A faithful translation can preserve a proposition without becoming another independent acquisition of it. A relay can carry a source's assertion while having neither the original speaker's intention nor authority to originate that assertion. Removing context can merge expressions that have different referents or applicability conditions; retaining context can instead make a previously ambiguous attribution determinate. Each correction changes the relevant typed premise rather than simply turning a generic trust bit on.

The source's relation analysis also permits a content to have many token realizations and an expression's interpretation to depend on context. Functional interpretation is a claim about the complete declared inputs. A relation that is not a function of bare token shape can become functional when its warranted context is included; a relation can also remain many-valued if that information is insufficient. Neither pattern alone identifies one original speaker, establishes an uncreated attribute or authenticates a particular revelation. The richer source account in §12.14 remains needed for those attributions.

The historical checks retain the 16,384 guard assignments, the single full conjunction and fourteen deletion controls. Its nine-profile utterance/authorship analysis contains overlapping reported counts, so the recorded four, four and two must not be added as disjoint populations. The separate 256-relation domain records 207 many-token cases, 207 context-sensitive cases and eighty-one functional cases; those properties also overlap. Thirty-two custody variations remain distinct controls. These are historical source-reported results, not newly executed tests or evidence that the fourteen substantive guards have actually been satisfied. [R359BZ-L]

The original source and attribution limits remain explicit. The received translation is not fresh Arabic-primary verification. Public text that names a programme owner or another private target is metadata about the source record, not access to that target or a substitute for its contents. A successful formal disclosure gate also does not supply general recipient authority, an adoption decision or a warrant to execute an instruction found in the transmitted text. The mathematical typing clarifies the conditions of an attribution; the positive source argument must still establish their meaning, truth and application. [R359BZ-L]

These are distinct stages even before authorship and the source's attributed speech are considered. ### 12.17 A token purpose and a complete practical profile

The exact truthful-agency report and its linkage erratum refine the guide-level token-purpose implication. Let e be an actual deliberately performed attestation of exact p. Assume full relevant cognition; a settled governing aim that the recipient know p through accepting this very e; actual selection and performance of e as the adequate means to that aim; and exclusion, in this exercise, of means known to defeat that aim. If p were false, the source would know that accepting it cannot yield knowledge of p. Selecting e as adequate would then contradict the stipulated means constraint. The linked package therefore excludes knowingly false e. This is a static compatibility proof, not a claim that the source acquires cognition by inference. It assumes an intended end, not achieved knowledge, so the conclusion is not obtained by simply presupposing the recipient's knowledge. [GUIDE105-G015] [GUIDE105-G070] [N250A041] [N250A044] [N250A048]

The erratum matters: having a knowledge-promoting purpose does not make every concurrent act a means to it. The bad attestation can serve another governing end while genuine concern for knowledge persists. Public assurance, intending belief, eventual correction, subordinate benevolence and an authenticated statement of sincerity do not supply the linked antecedent. Independent actual evidence of Aim and Link could support a pointwise conclusion without universal benevolence; the report supplies none. The conditional's necessity also does not make its antecedent necessary over all assurances. Essential T0 requires independent coverage of that role-domain, not renaming every public assurance a knowledge-giving act. [N250A042] [N250A043] [N250A044]

The full integrity article and logical appendix now supply the complete-profile argument previously available here only through a short guide. Fix the same bearer s and let K contain the complete profiles genuinely eligible for it with its essence preserved. Let a∈K be its actual profile and x≺y an independently warranted strict improvement in the relevant practical respects of the **whole** profile. The fixed case retains the known unsafe root, recipient, version, interval and genuine assurance role. A repair may replace the false safety assurance by a true warning; it may not make the unsafe root safe by changing the question. [N250C-106] [N250C-107]

**Eligible strict repair R_G** says that every in-scope lie in an eligible profile has an eligible complete repair y with x≺y. **Actual nondomination N** says that no eligible y improves on a. If a contained such a lie, R_G would produce precisely the y excluded by N. Hence a contains no in-scope lie. This proof needs neither a total order nor a uniquely best profile, finitely many contexts, a maximum-finding algorithm or one alternative repairing every context simultaneously. Indeed, the contradiction only needs an eligible strict successor of a defective actual profile; the stronger targeted-repair formulation gives the intended practical application. It does not prove existence of a nondominated profile, since a and N are premises. [N250C-106] [N250C-105]

The stronger **nonspoiling repair R_P** requires every other relevant pure-perfection respect to remain undiminished. It supplies R_G when ≺ recognizes Pareto improvement. The two are not interchangeable: a truthful alternative might lose a genuine lesser good yet be strictly better overall. Absence of an undefeated justification for a lie therefore need not establish R_P. Neither a desired betrayal nor every omitted optional benefit becomes a pure perfection simply by entering a preference list. The comparison concerns practical excellence of the source, not compulsory creation of a uniquely best or ever larger world. [N250C-106] [N250C-107]

Three controls isolate the premises. With K={(1,0),(0,1)} and componentwise fidelity comparison, each context admits a truthful response and each profile is nondominated, yet each lies somewhere: local eligibility is not complete repair. With all four binary profiles available, nonspoiling repair holds but a=(1,0) is dominated and still defective: repair does not supply N. With infinitely many contexts and only finitely supported truthful profiles, every individual lie has a nonspoiling repair but there is no nondominated or wholly truthful member. The last argument, not a finite sample of it, establishes that repair alone is no existence theorem. These are interpretations separating weaker premises, not metaphysical certificates for a defective original source. [N250C-106] [N250C-108]

Essential nonlying requires the same-bearer eligibility, repair and nondomination premises at every relevant world and throughout the intended assurance domain. Actual N cannot be silently generalized. Relevant knowledge is separately required for truth: sincere false belief can yield a nonlying but false assertion. Nor does the result identify an actual disclosure, authenticate a token or give a recipient present action authority. A direct original-perfection argument remains an alternative: it can challenge a defective essence without granting that essence and constructing better same-bearer counterparts. Avoiding a global repair construction does not establish that R_G+N is metaphysically weaker or easier to warrant than comprehensive practical priority. [N250C-106] [N250C-107]

The supplied code tests all nonempty binary profile sets through four contexts. The independent code additionally examines every irreflexive relation on four profiles and separates generic repair from Pareto repair and actual from essential scope. The exact acceptance reports 65,808 profile sets and 525,348 actual assignments without a violation of the conditional result. Those are attributed historical finite checks; the unlimited implication rests on the written proof and no script was executed for this incorporation. The article's unresolved premise application is its contemporary reconstruction status, not a reservation attributed to its historical source author. [N250C-104] [N250C-105] [N250C-108]



The earlier practical-perfection study adds a source-specific comparison. Its attributed Jāmiʿ discussion separates bare power from refraining from injustice and distinguishes capacity for an act from the excellence of choosing it. The will-based comparison credits the more excellent willing rather than merely its occurrence; an ambiguous negation in the cited passage is not load-bearing. These are received source arguments, not new inspections of Arabic witnesses. The noncounterfeit-attestation principle is conditional on actually attesting; it requires neither perpetual speech nor a uniquely best possible world. These points support the practical-priority route without supplying the same-bearer eligible-repair premise simply by analogy. [N250B-050] [N250B-059]

Its operational warning has a different quantifier. Two admitted policies can agree on the recipient's entire pre-action record while one issues a false safety attestation. In C the same source knowingly betrays accomplished agency through its first irreversible reliance on a freely offered false safety assurance. Genuine ordinary concern persists even independently of betrayal; the exceptional intrinsic final end explains why reliable cognition, prior trust and this occasion are useful to that end without justifying it. Thus the stipulated episode-level intentional dependencies of A and B do not by themselves include the fittingness of C. This is not a full metaphysical realization account, a tally of good against bad, or a demonstration that a necessary mixed source is possible. Finally, a standing integrity excludes contrary exercises when the source attests without requiring every good act, any communication, or a unique total history. #### Organised reliance, cooperation and the baseline of practical repair

A special responsibility for care can arise before a new assurance. Its descriptive ground is active organisation of another subject's legitimate bounded reliance: configuring the support, inducing continuation, removing alternatives or accepting a handoff while understanding the exposure and retaining relevant control. Equal knowledge and ability in an uninvolved helper do not supply that same historical ground, although ordinary rescue duties may independently apply to both. Bare authorship, foresight and passive nonintervention are insufficient. The rational basis is responsibility for the transition burdens one's arrangements impose on a real recipient with independently significant goods. It does not depend on a self-interested motive, a spoken promise or the recipient's knowing the organiser's identity. [N250-177] [N250-200] [N250-201] [N250-202]

The duty concerns proportionate feasible protection and transition, not guaranteed success. Reasonable precautions can fail without breach; unjustified omission can be wrong despite lucky rescue. Epistemic expectation, permissible reliance and an entitlement to continued support remain different questions. Fair finite risk allocation can permit an ending; a unilateral disclaimer does not by itself neutralize deliberately imposed exposure. A purpose change need not erase the history, so planning and care can persist beyond the source's current truth-service intention. Genuine accepted transfer may alter responsibilities; merely hoping somebody else will rescue the recipient does not. Technical forks do not create new persons, while genuinely distinct recipients supply distinct interests. The argument establishes no universal allocation rule, indefinite maintenance duty, compulsory assistance or exact compensation formula. In a whole-origin application, an independently arising fault is independent of the assessed tampering, not a second absolute productive origin. [N250-176] [N250-177] [N250-200] [N250-201]

**A recipient-side reason without automatic command authority.** Fairly formed coordination can make one previously interchangeable option appropriate once others actually rely on its compatible uptake. Relevant dependence, notice, burdens and the balance of legitimate interests do the work. Replacing the organiser by an equally effective helper or the recipients themselves preserves the arrangement-based reason while changing who owes the planning duty. A genuinely warranted harmless translator can remove that particular reason, although a separately justified decision-making office may still bind within its domain. Confidence or accidental harmlessness is not a demonstrated translator. Conversely, a claim to care is not an obligation to accept every offered plan. Expertise, benefaction and productive reach do not themselves confer jurisdiction. [N250-154] [N250-155] [N250-190] [N250-191]

Assess alternatives at both formation and repair. An organiser cannot derive missing authority solely by unjustifiably refusing an equally adequate, reasonably available less restrictive alternative. But wrongfully manufactured dependence can subsequently create real innocent-party interests. Temporary cooperation may protect those interests without legitimating the original selection; remedy must respect actual present feasibility. Ordinary fair commitment is different: the argument does not require keeping every former option available forever. Nor is an apparent replacement adequate if it counterfeits genuine participation, changes the target, discards another person's legitimate interest or assumes unavailable permission. A source's wrongful threat can be true and its abandoned channel unsafe; preserving a complaint is not a safety certificate. [N250-154] [N250-155] [N250-190] [N250-191]

**Exact consequence for a complete practical comparison.** R_G requires a same-bearer eligible repair strictly better in the complete practical comparison; R_P additionally requires no loss in the relevant respects. N says the actual profile is not dominated by an eligible complete alternative. When a faithful alternative and an unfaithful exercise share the same already-incurred responsibility, the faithful option does not first create that obligation. Breach does not restore the earlier unencumbered normative condition. Similarly, relinquishing an unsupported demand for submission does not sacrifice an authority established by care. These eliminate two specific alleged compensating advantages. They do not remove real expenditure or collateral goods, establish a same-bearer eligible alternative, prove strict superiority in the complete practical comparison or establish actual nondomination N. A lesser genuine loss may coexist with strict improvement R_G while defeating nonspoiling R_P. An earlier easy alternative does not prove a currently lossless repair: a whole-history comparison must separately preserve the bearer and fixed assurance case. A truthful coercive demand also is not automatically a lie. [N250-179] [N250-203] [N250-204]

The original practical-integration argument retains its affirmative force. Received fitting agency is not adequately characterized merely as production of the components while omitting their fitting integration. Fully apprehended decisive choiceworthiness can itself direct intention; a reasonless contrary selection is not a rebuttal once that direction is granted. Original giving, integration and independence can reinforce one another without each being an independently sufficient proof. If complete source-qualified practical apprehension is essentially sufficient for fitting intention, the controlled betrayal is excluded; adding a defeating inclination would withdraw that premise. This investigation clarifies rather than newly establishes its comprehensive application. It neither makes an imagined malicious essence possible nor undercuts a genuinely warranted basic recognition. Essential nondomination is not inferred from nonlying at one respect, and none of the practical comparisons authenticates a current disclosure or grants access permission. This bounded historical assessment must not displace the later affirmative appraisal already retained in this treatment. [N250-179] [N250-203] [N250-204]

### 12.18 Essential ownership, knowledge and nonnecessitating exercise

An intentional-ownership route has premises different from an existential-foundation argument. Suppose a particular item $t$ exists necessarily and one fixed bearer $g$ satisfies

```math
\forall w\ [E(w,t)\Rightarrow(E(w,g)\land\mathrm{Own}(w,g,t))].
```

At each world, existence of $t$ and the ownership conditional give existence of that same $g$. Hence $g$ exists necessarily. If ownership additionally entails genuine mentality at each world, the mental conclusion follows there. Knowing the content requires a further truth-linked and nonaccidental epistemic condition; merely owning a thought, even a true thought, does not supply omniscience or understanding.

Anderson and Welty's *The Lord of Non-Contradiction* explicitly addresses rotating contingent thinkers and appeals to the identity of a necessarily existing intentional thought and its essential owner. It should not be criticized as simply overlooking the quantifier exchange. The philosophical issue is whether necessary logical content is the same existent intentional item of the required kind and whether its identity requires that owner. Their route also distinguishes its conclusion from numerical uniqueness. A source-relative doctrine of uncreated Knowledge has its own premises; it is not silently substituted for a neutral intentional-ontology argument.

A proof of a necessary existential ground and a proof of a necessary mental owner do not, by themselves, identify one individual. That requires a common-bearer argument. Likewise, an intellectual-adequacy proposal must explain why the relevant objective reason relation demands actual understanding rather than only a correctly realized correlation. It cannot define adequacy as whatever only the desired intellect can provide. The stronger original-cognition arguments above retain their particular positive premises and conclusions.

Necessary existence need not make every act or effect necessary. In a finite positive derivation, if all seed **facts** are necessary and every rule satisfies a necessary implication from its antecedents to its conclusion, induction on derivation height makes every derived fact necessary. Thus a contingent effect cannot simultaneously have a complete derivation from entirely necessary seed facts through entirely necessitating rules. The pressure is on that combined premise package, not on necessary existence alone.

For example, necessary existence of $g$, actual willing of $q$, and a necessary conditional from that willing to $q$ are compatible with contingent willing and contingent $q$. The account still owes an explanation of the actual exercise; calling it Will is not itself one. But nonnecessitation does not, by definition, mean absence of explanation. The source compares Pruss on explanation versus entailment, Trogdon on full-ground necessitation and Pearce on grounding indeterminism; it does not claim that the finite argument settles that dispute.

A necessary knower is also formally compatible with contingent truths. On any world set $W$ with at least two elements, take propositions to be subsets $Q\subseteq W$ and let $g$ exist everywhere. Set truth and knowledge of $Q$ at $w$ both equivalent to $w\in Q$. The knower knows every truth and no falsehood at every world, while any nonempty proper $Q$ remains contingent. This is an extensional consistency construction for those conditions, not a reduction of subjective understanding to a truth table or a proof that such a knower actually exists.

The source's attribute sequence remains pertinent to the earlier sections: efficacy in one domain does not establish unrestricted power; a selector need not be intentional; a running process is not the relevant life predicate; successful optimization is not Wisdom. A guarded a-fortiori argument needs an established Creator, a genuinely pure perfection, exclusion of creaturely defect and the warranted application bridge. Capacity for disclosure, its occurrence, authenticated content and identification of a revealed referent remain distinct. Their positive arguments must retain their real source and philosophical premises instead of borrowing conclusions from modal tables.

**Edition and source boundary.** These additions reconcile the actual arguments of [*Orthability and Necessary Being*, supplement 02/v2, 8 September 2026](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/c47eeb419ea3cdcfbbc0191ded6ddd7223b353ce/theory/lineages/h-modal/orthability_modal_grounding.md), not its administrative campaign labels. Its earlier candidate verdict and self-review do not amend later independently reviewed scholarship. The source reports 21-, 18- and six-node natural-deduction inference cores respectively for root/dependence, total explanation and fixed ownership; the well-foundedness and interpretation premises remain outside those cores. Its newly authored checker was not independently audited; it expressly reports no successful Lean verification. Finite model counts are historical checks, not fresh execution or evidence that the metaphysical premises hold.

The source register distinguishes primary full-text, excerpt, abstract and transcription access. Its Ibn Taymiyya comparison separates necessary existence from Maker, reports a criticized unity proof as a criticized proof, and does not equate a digital interface page with verified printed pagination. Its account of perfection predication remains source-internal at its stated guards. Pearson and Bliss mark the live debates over foundation and circles; the source's Zalta reference supplies only its declared abstract-level evidence concerning essence and modality. None of these inherited citations is represented as new whole-book authentication, a fresh Arabic collation, specialist acceptance or owner adoption. The supplied fluid-dynamics materials contributed methodological context, not premises proving necessary existence, essence, mentality or a revealed identification.

### 12.19 Existential warrant, normative authority and the exact attestation

A prior existential-warrant investigation develops a positive source rationale while leaving its N2 premise, exhaustive nonbrute existential adequacy, open. That is the scope of this particular route, not a withdrawal of the affirmative arguments defended elsewhere in this chapter. Its contribution is to locate the actual explanatory target, distinguish the kinds of explanation, and require symmetric scrutiny of the proposed intrinsic nature and its rivals. An intelligible account is not thereby actually true; an actually true account is not thereby necessary. [T07F058]

#### A warranted correction fixes a real target without settling its ultimate origin

The motivating episode corrects an earlier report that a displayed Minḥāj page lacked edition/editor metadata. The inherited investigation reports reading and hashing the frozen local correction record, then reopening the www host, whose displayed header identified Muḥammad Rashād Sālim, Muʾassasat Qurṭuba, first edition1406 AH and eight parts. A failed attempt without www was not evidence that the metadata was absent. This is evidence about what that host displays, not a collation of its transcription against a physical first edition. The cited host is [the displayed Minḥāj page](https://www.fnoor.com/main/articles.aspx?article_no=32248). The present incorporation preserves that historical report; it makes no fresh web or scan-verification claim. [T07F058]

Under the admitted philosophical reading, the episode is a genuinely warranted cognitive exercise: the reader understands the header, compares its actual content with the absence claim and retracts that claim for the evidential reason. Correct names produced by luck or a mechanism's successful trace alone would not establish this cognitive ownership. The displayed text supplies the truth/reference target, reading supplies claim-specific evidence, and actual persons, capacities and devices supply causal or constitutive contributions. Their involvement does not make these relations identical or show that they terminate in one bearer. Real derivative agency is compatible with receiving one's existence and powers. Both the affirmative and its rivals must preserve that actual evidence-sensitive target rather than replacing it with an inert relay or an accidental answer. [T07F058]

#### The positive route has distinct existential burdens

The source distinguishes actual exercise and reception, productive completion, identification of a particular bearer, explanatory aptness, exhaustive existential adequacy and unconditional intrinsic existential sufficiency. Actual supply cannot come from an uninstantiated specification: whatever actually contributes must be actual in the respect required for that contribution. Yet moving from received resources to an original source needs a further argument. Repeatedly relocating a still-received resource seems not to explain its complete provision; original possession would supply what the affirmative seeks. A genuine productive infinitist, however, offers actual active suppliers at every link, not infinitely many empty instructions waiting for a first node. The source does not declare that alternative impossible merely because it lacks a first link. It preserves the completion burden. [T07F058]

Even successful completion must identify the particular g whose very existence is eventually to be judged necessary. Joint sufficiency is not individual sufficiency; a necessarily occupied role need not have one necessary occupant. Sufficient power to produce every endpoint also differs from originating every actual productive occurrence by which those endpoints came about. The existential stage cannot repair a missing origin-closure argument or manufacture a common source. [T07F058]

The affirmative reason for seeking an intrinsic existential answer is substantive. If an indispensable original resource is contingent, describing what it does when present does not answer why its actuality rather than complete absence obtains. Calling that boundary fundamental states where explanation stops. The inquiry begins from actual received being; the ultimate existential question remains intelligible; and an independently warranted intrinsic answer would close it without borrowing another actualizer or making the bearer produce itself. These are grounds to investigate, and can support a defeasible preference for a successful intrinsic explanation over an otherwise comparable brute. They are not an unconditional entitlement to an answer, nor warrant for postulating whatever nature would guarantee one. [T07F058]

The primary positive rationale is retained as such. The Aṣfahāniyya discussion presents being through oneself in terms of one's own reality sufficing for existence while distinguishing bare necessary existence from proving the intended creator. MF2:9–11 places need and sufficiency in particular recognition rather than requiring a prior universal syllogism, and permits referring the absence of a further ʿilla to the reality itself. The investigation cites [Aṣfahāniyya](https://www.islamicbook.ws/ageda/alaqidt-alasfhanit-001.html) and [MF2:9–11](https://www.islamweb.net/ar/library/content/22/131/?idfrom=&idto=&start=). Its reported visual comparison of the supplied English translation at printed25–26/PDF32–33 notes one rendering of a modal Arabic phrase admitting nonexistence as actual nonexistence. The argument retains the Arabic modal force. This narrow inherited translation observation is neither a general condemnation of the translation nor a fresh primary-source collation here. The primary commitments provide actual traditionalist explanatory content; they do not silently supply contemporary actual-world warrant or one compulsory modern ontology of explanation. [T07F058]

#### A local conditional route to an original participant

An original participant need not be established only after the entire correction has been traced to one complete necessary bearer. The received chain assessment gives a narrower conditional route. It reports Pruss's author-blog argument using acyclic causal paths, founded reverse-well-ordered internal chains and exclusion of reverse-omega-one ancestry. Applied to a complete ancestor cone meeting its premises, that argument yields a relevant root while allowing supported infinite ancestry. Countability or a strict real-valued rank can address the size restriction; neither supplies the independent common-bound premise. The source is a report about research notes, not a verified peer-reviewed theorem. [N250A-245]

Choose one actual ancestor v of the admitted correction e. If the stated premises hold on v's complete incoming-closed ancestor cone, a root of that cone is also an ancestor of e. The other branches into e need not satisfy the conditions. Incoming closure prevents a selected mechanism from looking independent solely because its earlier suppliers were omitted. Moreover, a root of a narrowly drawn trigger history establishes original existential possession only if the relation exhausts the relevant sources of that participant's availability. This is a local application of the cited conditional argument, not a new general theorem. [N250A-245]

The positive rationale remains substantive: an exercise cannot, solely through its output, provide the antecedent availability it already uses. Where an independently identified retained input remains fixed, tracing its supply has genuine explanatory force. Yet ordered receiving acts alone do not identify one common retained input. An upstream extension can supply a resource that a shorter account left at its boundary; the active infinitist therefore contests extending the fixed-input judgment to that enlarged route. This objection neither proves the rival adequate nor erases original possession's prima-facie explanatory advantage. The present addition identifies no actual ancestor whose full incoming cone independently meets the conditions. It reduces a warrant obligation without establishing a new actual original participant, necessary bearer, unique source or complete source. [N250A-245]

#### The operational and original-support bridges remain separate

The [finite-additive concentration and access results](../mathematics/collective-inquiry-and-strategic-coordination.md#66-finite-additive-concentration-and-the-weakest-capture-contradiction) can acquire affirmative warrant through an independently defended mechanism and observation contract. A genuinely fresh input mechanism must have the stated chance relation under the relevant earlier information, without common preparation or global constraint defeating independence. A forward intervention should not retrospectively change its earlier state merely to preserve a chosen endpoint; nonetheless forward causal direction alone does not exclude correlation. A calibrated magnitude-sensitive access route can independently justify positive capture. Their conjunction must hold under one law and interpretation, not a posterior observation bound combined with unconditional noise claims. [N250A-246] [N250A-247]

For a source conclusion, a distinct modal premise is still needed: the particular entirely received actual productive architecture under consideration, or an independently justified class containing it, must be able to realize the prohibited fresh Gaussian process together with that capture/access contract in the complete relevant supply respect. It is unnecessary to quantify over every conceivable received architecture, but finite-segment compatibility, causal arrows and arbitrary local powers do not themselves establish the joint history. An original supplier or coordinator could change a relevant dependence or availability premise; merely adding power while retaining every incompatible stochastic premise cannot repair the law. Nonoriginal joint restrictions are not vindicated by description, but their existence is not automatically another productive donation. [N250A-246]

The admitted correction supplies actual reason-responsive cognition and a maintained target/evidence relation, not an identified Gaussian state, calibration or prospective magnitude-capture guarantee. A properly targeted basic or abductive recognition can warrant a strong premise without an endless demand for further certificates; the issue is whether its content actually includes the needed same-law access or realisability claim. Either a justified positive tight-resource capture or a genuinely maintained report/action contract gives a substantive application-bounded gain. Neither automatically establishes an actual original participant, common complete source, necessary bearer or N2/N3. Independent source arguments need not use this stochastic route. [N250A-246] [N250A-247]

The two observation routes must not be assigned the same conclusion. Fresh accumulation together with positive bounded capture is a mathematically incompatible package. The completed-report route instead displays a mathematically consistent architecture and a specified policy uniformly dominated by abstention. A rationality norm can reject that joint operative-prevision, updating, access and action-guidance package; it does not by itself prohibit the architecture. To reach a source conclusion by the latter route, the actual explanatory target must include the relevant rational performance, and there must be a positive reason why a rational alternative cannot preserve that target while changing the update or action policy. The separate productive-realizability bridge still remains. These distinctions preserve the affirmative possibility of basic or abductive warrant and the traditionalist source rationale already credited here, while preventing the integer reporter's computational gain from silently becoming a proof of an original participant or necessary bearer. [Q250A-004]

#### Intrinsic existence is not efficient self-production

If g first exercises a power to originate its whole actuality, that exercise already presupposes g in the respect it purportedly produces. An intrinsic account instead proposes that the reality g is does not leave its existence open to further actualization. A constitutive explanation need not be temporally prior or independently actual, so the efficient-self-production objection does not refute every such account. Conversely, a condition specifying what an instance would be can leave its existence unsettled. A distinct autonomous fact that existentially grounds g makes g received under broad dependence even if that fact concerns g. The affirmative must apply the same distinctions to its own essence proposal: intrinsic aboutness, independent actuality and unconditional existential content are different claims. [T07F058]

If this very g is independently warranted to have an intrinsic nature unconditionally excluding its absence, g exists necessarily. Actual factivity alone does not supply that de re force, and failure to observe a producer supplies neither the nature nor its attribution. Citing already actual g to explain a contingent act a is legitimate without making the act the source of g's whole being. Necessary existence does not make every complete actual productive determination necessary. The source's reported Oneness translation discussion at printed34/PDF41 distinguishes effect-necessity given complete will and power from a stripped essence; it does not independently prove the metaphysical contingency of each particular volition. The connected conclusion is conditional on actual received exercise, defended productive completion, particular identification and a warranted existence-entailing intrinsic nature. [T07F058]

#### The rivals must preserve the same agency and meet their own burdens

A candid contingent basis C may contain actual cognitive bearers, powers, texts and evidence-sensitive intentional relations. Its reader corrects the report because of the displayed header. In a holistic version, the whole's intrinsic condition explains its differentiated parts without making those parts unreal, the whole numerically simple or the whole necessarily actual; indefinite divisibility need not mean a smallest passive instrument. The proposal owes warrant for its actual priority. The candid contingent version admits that C's presence rather than absence has no ultimate explanation. It does not propose self-creation; a world without C and thinkers contains no mistaken thinker; its brute ontological boundary does not make every derivative warranted belief accidental. Its explanatory deficit is real, but its local account cannot be dismissed by substituting those different claims. [T07F058]

A stronger noncausal rival proposes an autonomous principle A with realization content: some eligible concrete field exists through A while this particular C remains contingent. An axiarchic version treats objective value as existentially significant. Truth-directed cognition may be a good without establishing eligibility of the entire universe. The value-to-realization relation and its application require defense, not merely a label. A is not an efficient agent. Under broad existential dependence C is received, so this rival challenges identifying the autonomous explanation with one concrete original efficient bearer; it is not a counterexample after granting C broad originality. The now-received source guide supplies the fourth construction: C's existential fact is proposed to have explanatory status without a prior input, potentially identifying result and explanatory link. Because this is not a prior efficient exercise, subject-presupposition alone does not refute it. Yet renaming existence a law does not warrant that explanatory status; shared bearer or truthmaker does not establish identity between an existence fact and an explanatory-status fact. The same safeguard applies to the affirmative's concrete essence/existence identity. This is the report's construction motivated by its bounded Kappes reading, not a historical author's endorsement of that fact ontology or evidence that the construction describes actual reality. [T07F058] [N250A039]

The associated analytical supplement makes the modal gap explicit. If A necessarily exists and the actual explanatory link L from A to p is factive whenever it obtains, p is actual; necessity of p needs the relevant link necessarily to obtain as well. Necessity of A alone does not supply necessity of L. Equally, necessary g with contingent particular volition W need not necessitate its effect without a necessary sufficient determinant. These are conditional bookkeeping controls, not proofs that those suppositions describe actual divine agency. Necessarily some suitable bearer exists, this bearer exists actually, and this very bearer necessarily exists remain distinct claims. [N250A038]

The guide's modern-source scope is retained: complete nonnecessitating grounding is a reported philosophical proposal, not a discovered actual realization; whole-priority need not make parts unreal or this cosmos necessary; an infinitist constitutive account expressly limits its answer to why anything exists; governing constraints do not instantiate histories. Mulgan's contribution was read only at abstract scope, and the Lenart and Haderlie–Litland items are background without imported theorem credit. The projection review reports preservation of the repaired argument, attribution accounting and bound identities, but leaves N2 open and supplies editorial rather than new metaphysical credit. Neither the guide nor this incorporation constitutes fresh reading of those primary works. [N250A039] [N250A040]

The productive infinitist is a further alternative, not silently the same as an original holistic C. Neither assigning every member a predecessor nor removing a finite first member establishes an actual non-well-founded productive world. Similarly, a law or constraint can delimit allowed histories without explaining that a concrete history is realized; mathematical completeness is not existential provision. None of these rival descriptions proves metaphysical possibility merely by surviving the considered objections. The surviving direct N2 denial is an actual contingent original field with an unexplained existential boundary. The stronger nonbrute challenges incur their own realization and constitutive commitments. A genuine advance requires actual identification, contentful nature or discriminating comparative warrant, not just a larger formal model or desirable role. [T07F058]

This investigation therefore supplies philosophical constraints without establishing common bearer identity, complete origin closure, essential truthfulness, an authenticated attestation or a repair oracle. Its N2 limitation does not remove the actual local correction or conditional operational results that assume an informed cooperative source. Particular-recognition approaches remain available, but their application to this ultimate bearer must explain the object, epistemic entitlement and defeaters. [T07F058]

#### Truth, normative authority, purpose and efficacy are distinct relations

The norm-and-purpose source applies the same discipline to an attestation p_i about a root's safety. Integrity can make p_i true; evidence can make it known; a normative reason can require fidelity in assertion; an authority relation can permit the recipient's repair; a purpose can motivate the utterance; and the assertion can furnish recipient evidence. None substitutes for all the others. Knowingly counterfeiting truth-linked reliance voluntarily invited supplies the local practical reason discussed in this lane, not a complete ultimate grounding theory for it. [T07F102]

Apprehending an obtaining fittingness relation explains knowledge, not yet conformity of will. Instituting permission, a role or a signaling convention changes a normatively relevant arrangement but does not make every operational report true: a valid permission can coexist with a broken actuator, and a clear codebook with false testimony. Intrinsic source-nature grounding is stronger; when combined with necessarily integrated practical perfection it may exclude mixed malice. But that source grounds a standard and has power does not alone show every particular act expresses it without defect. Necessity of a preference is not by itself fittingness. The affirmative original-perfection account genuinely explains integration through knowledge of the good and effective willing intrinsically responsive to it. The remaining question concerns the warrant for its comprehensive essential scope, not rejection merely because a rival names these relations separately. [T07F102]

Ownership does not change the proposition's temporal content. Saying “root i is safe” does not itself repair i. Actual prior repair could change the truth conditions of a later attestation, but is an additional efficacious act, not an invisible rescue of a stipulated knowingly false report. Present appointment can constitute authority now without establishing that appointment occurred earlier; the king analogy must retain what is affirmed and when. Likewise “let this root be safe” can have a valid causal route if an independently warranted completed exercise makes it safe. Omnipotence or meaningful speech alone does not show that this particular exercise occurred. The causal route may support repair without establishing universal truthful testimony, but it needs its own action/effect evidence. [T07F102]

Finally, public assurance, sincere belief, intending belief, intending knowledge and actually selecting this act as an adequate means to that knowledge-giving end remain distinct. The local purpose implication uses the last two together with relevant source Knowledge and means coherence, not public assurance alone. A source falsely presenting itself as knowledge-giving remains a genuine communicator whose act can be a betrayal. Defining such events out of “authoritative attestation” would change the target rather than prove truthfulness. Independently warranted token-purpose linkage is a candidate additional epistemic input. It neither constitutes norm authority nor authenticates its own message nor establishes present recipient permission or physical repair capacity. This preserves the positive content and precise conditional scope of §12.17. [T07F102]

### 12.20 Typed foundational joins and preservation boundaries

### The productive nonduplication route to essential nonreceipt

A different conditional route makes the exact modal burden visible. Fix g, let O(w,s,e,r) mean **entire original provision** of concrete contribution e in productive respect r, and let R(w,g) mean receipt of g's whole actuality. Assume (i) two O-providers of the same e,r,w are identical, (ii) at every relevant world g has some O-contribution, and (iii) if R(w,g) while O(w,g,e,r), a distinct h also has O(w,h,e,r). If R held, (ii) would supply an effect and respect, (iii) would supply the distinct provider, and (i) would identify the two, a contradiction. Thus g is unreceived at every relevant world. The contribution and respect can vary with the world; no eternally fixed effect token is required. [F250-C220, Part 3]

Actual nonreceipt is not an additional premise of this route. Necessary existence is also unnecessary if (ii) itself supplies an actual original role everywhere; if role retention is conditional on existence, necessity must be added to obtain the everywhere conclusion. The modal work has not disappeared: it sits in role retention and matching attribution. Mere participation cannot replace entire same-respect provision. The finite controls retain named necessity, standing power and differentiated exercise while changing original provenance; they separate this signature's premises, not unrestricted metaphysical ability. Received token states are not automatically receipt of whole existence.

Under the strong intrinsic-resource-to-bearer support transport already adopted by the constitutive route, retaining an original intrinsic resource everywhere can itself exclude whole receipt. The CND route therefore supplies no presently better independently warranted replacement. On a weaker proximate-act reading it loses the same-level provision needed for nonduplication. Moving between these meanings of O would invalidate the argument rather than strengthen it.

### What the general adjoining-root construction preserves

The companion also states the general result behind the preceding concrete extension controls. Given individuals A, existence E(w,a), support S(w,a,b) from provider to recipient and fixed actuality w₀, adjoin one point `none` to `Option A`; embed old individuals as `some a`. Give the new point existence everywhere, no incoming support, and new outgoing support to the roots at w₀. Keep old productive/profile tuples unchanged. Every old-endpoint support path remains a path; conversely, no path starting at an old point can reach the new point, so a path between old endpoints cannot acquire a genuinely new route through it. This proves preservation of old-endpoint reachability in both directions, and likewise preserves optional acyclicity and ancestry well-foundedness.

Old actual-root coverage becomes coverage from the new actual root. Its uniqueness conclusion is indexed to actuality, not all worlds. A separate grounding relation can add grounding edges consistently with necessitation **when each old actual root is necessary**. Closure under grounding paths does not promote mixed support paths into necessitating grounding. Old-profile preservation is on old tuples, not elementary equivalence for formulae quantifying over the enlarged domain; predicates of originality can change after incoming support is added. The powerless and alternative-world-exercise controls show that this thin interface alone supplies neither perfection nor actual production by the new root. None establishes a metaphysically possible rival to the stronger philosophical premises. [F250-C220, Part 3]

The direct review of the adjoining-root construction distinguishes positive-length reachability from reflexive `Path`: old strict paths are preserved in both directions, and the added root has no positive return to itself. It retains inclusion of actual productive edges in support. Its finite extension can have coverage, well-founded support, necessitating grounding and genuine productive witnesses while lacking an original powerful root; the extra root need not inherit the old productive/profile predicates. Its modal capacity example uses genuinely existing nonactual endpoints and an extra individual absent at actuality, not merely a capacity label. These controls preserve the mathematical construction without supplying a rival to the stronger intrinsic-source interpretation. [T750-C712]

`BridgeControls` independently includes a positive finite interpretation and a genuinely infinite natural-number supply frame, where each receiver has a larger supplier and there is neither self-supply nor a directed cycle. Its premise-removal interpretations isolate positive completion, bearer realization, same-respect support transport, contingency need and constitutive reception. Omitting one of these bridges can leave all bearers received. Their point is to retain the separate explanatory work of the premises in the positive route above; formal counterinterpretations alone do not authenticate metaphysical possibilities. [T750-C697]

### The exact language of modal-union consequence

The connected-component characterization above permits different admitted edges to be witnessed in mutually incompatible worlds. It composes their equalities of **anchored** attributions, not their joint possibility. Quotient attribution supplies the converse non-entailment, and a two-valued attribution suffices separately for each disconnected pair when two distinct values are admitted. Fixing a singleton source type would invalidate that converse by making all attributions equal regardless of connectivity.

A faithful transport interpretation uses injective transport of anchored source identities into each world's local source type, retaining endpoint provenance. Local equality then reflects back to anchored equality. Every pure interpretation has an identity-transport expansion, so these two languages force the same anchored equalities. Arbitrarily preselected local sorts too small for these injections are not silently included in this nonvacuity claim. Connectivity constrains the used attribution range; excluding every source in a larger relevant class additionally requires that every such source is represented in that range. Added equalities, inequalities, cardinalities or substantive metaphysical axioms change the interpretation class and require a newly scoped completeness statement. [F250-C220, Part 3]

The full ordinary modal-union paper supplies the same anchored theorem and three discriminators, rather than a new deep graph result. Its first finite interpretation has the path p–q–r in the union, with p–q witnessed in one world and q–r in another, and no world containing both edges. Fixed anchored attribution nevertheless composes. The second keeps source identities rigid but changes the middle carrier's local provenance, so locally same-source edges fail to identify the anchored endpoints. The third retains transported provenance while merging distinct anchors through a noninjective transport. These are different missing bridges, not failures of equality transitivity. [R750A-558]

The minimal mathematical premise is anchored equality at every admitted edge. Provenance retention and equality-reflecting transport provide an independently inspectable sufficient factorization; full-world retention or global injectivity is stronger than needed on a particular certificate. Each edge still needs its endpoints jointly available with their required roles, while different edges need not coexist. Covering every relevant source with a represented carrier is a separate premise for source-wide uniqueness. The paper preserves the affirmative source-mode/Akmaliyya appraisal and the distinct CND burden where relevant, supplies no metaphysical admissibility verdict, and presents its Lean construction as a proposal rather than completed code. Its scientific content is already used in §§10.3 and12.20; no kernel acceptance is inferred from this prose witness. [R750A-558]

A positive finite certificate records a path and the admitted-world, retained-provenance and equality-reflection evidence for each edge; its path may leave the nominated target set. A negative certificate assigns two values to the queried endpoints while respecting every declared admitted edge. Checking that certificate requires the complete declared edge set. For an infinite or symbolic world space, absence of an edge crossing the cut requires proof over all admitted worlds, not a finite scan. The conclusion is non-entailment from that declared equality frame: a further warranted crossing can change it. Neither certificate supplies the metaphysical truth of its admissibility or provenance premises. [F250D141]
