### A common interpretation does not collapse the foundational premises

The Twentieth companion's architecture distinguishes worlds, bearers, resources and received targets. Actual originality of a resource is actuality plus nonreceipt; actual originality of a bearer is existence plus whole nonreceipt. Neither definition includes necessity, uniqueness or perfection. Positive Completion supplies a relevant original resource for an actual received target; Realisation supplies its intrinsic bearer; same-respect SupportTransport says whole receipt of that bearer entails receipt of that very intrinsic resource. Contradiction therefore yields an original bearer while retaining the target/resource/bearer linkage. An actual organism's possession of intrinsic powers alone would not establish its originality. Support transport is not an efficient bearer-to-attribute production edge. [F250-C220, Part 2, A–C]

For the *same* actual original g, contingency-as-need excludes nonnecessity. The broad receipt predicate requires a separate ReceiptRepresentation adapter before it can be identified with existential binary receipt. The broad necessity/nonreceipt result survives without that adapter, while binary UniformRoot need not. ConstitutiveReception separately says receipt of this same individual at one world implies receipt wherever it exists; actual originality then excludes receipt at every world where g exists. Necessity is not needed for this narrower essential-nonreceipt inference, but supplies existence everywhere for uniform roothood. Actual nonreceipt plus necessity alone does not prove it, and generic constitutive receipt does not fix a supplier identity. These are qualified positive arguments, not an empty label “necessary” supplying the premises.

The inherited Sixth theorem uses an inhabited domain, irreflexive transitive ancestry r, reflexive Below, and local complete cover of **every ancestor** of each target. Finite undirected connectedness plus those local covers gives a common least ancestor and unique root. Unique roothood at one target is weaker: it needs ancestral support throughout its cone. The infinite Fork separates these claims; a different rooted infinite control shows global well-foundedness unnecessary. Reflexive self-coverage is not self-production. Translating the incidence model into independently interpreted Sixth ancestry remains a general obligation: fix actual domain and source nodes, preserve every incoming branch/history and prove the requisite-to-ancestral-coverage bridge instead of defining a relation after the fact to force the conclusion. [F250-C220, Part 2, D]

The field theorem separately combines source qualification, classification of incomplete relevant exercise as a mode defect, and actual defect-free conformance. These supply complete provision in the qualified source's applicable roles. Sound use carries represented participation to actual original involvement; role applicability brings that involvement under the norm. Visibility runs in the converse direction, representing every actual original contributor. Genuine shared requisites propagate coverage along paths, field-restricted CND identifies providers, and positivity guards uniqueness among Complete-labelled providers. Standing solo ability, actual sufficiency, exclusive exhaustion, nonexclusive entire same-respect provision and differentiated contributions remain five different claims. Neither standing ability nor CND alone proves the actual mode premise. A shared source label does not transfer ownership of every created act or assertion. [F250-C220, Part 2, E–H]

The companion's joint finite interpretation supplies one literal common g across selected resource, field and speech signatures, not merely three separately inhabitable components. It includes necessary outside h, contingent received x, real differentiated production, an explicit incoming inventory and true g-owned but false creature-owned speech. Its source permutation, new incoming-edge and enlarged-field controls test genuine joins: separate component success does not establish linked resource provenance, complete ancestry or connected common coverage. Such simultaneous inhabitation establishes selected-signature consistency relative to the underlying mathematics, not two metaphysically perfect sources or truth of all actual-world premises.

Veracity retains its own burden. K supplies knowledge of falsity for a false owned content; local awareness and deliberate control, D's classification of knowing counterfeit as a declarative shortcoming, N's exclusion of such a shortcoming from fitting exercise, P's fittingness of actual exercises, and the ownership-to-exercise bridge contradict a false controlled owned assertion. The positive proof does not use factivity. Global awareness/control coverage extends it across the stated occasion domain. D is not N: a rescue objection may retain the shortcoming classification while contesting all-things exclusion. Strong informed ownership can retain awareness/control without truth or fittingness. Truthful speech also does not imply generic practical perfection. T0 source truthfulness remains separate from D1 actual occurrence/content/ownership and D2 the recipient's warranted authentication; source production alone supplies neither D1 nor D2. A true assertion that a duty obtains need not constitute that duty, and an imperative still needs rightful force, scope and safe implementation. [F250-C220, Part 2, Attributes and veracity]

The companion preserves substantive open obligations: warranted mandatory complete source-mode provision, independently justified CND, unrestricted contribution/respect individuation, the full perfection ascent, the general Sixth refinement, veracity's N against the rescue objection, and actual authentication. Conditional validity, nonvacuity, philosophical premise warrant and actual application warrant are four different achievements. The historical bounded reviews improve confidence in their respective entailments and joins without resolving all four. Their theorem/declaration counts, adapted import replay and source-paragraph erratum remain archival evidence rather than newly executed results here.


<a id="foundation250-historical-reconstruction-boundary"></a>

**Historical reconstruction and completed bridges.** The preimplementation reconstruction distinguishes the reports' philosophical judgments from their inferential dependencies. T17 affirmatively appraises the same actual Necessary Being, essential whole-existence independence and qualified attribute/veracity arguments. T18 retains those conclusions while withholding the unrestricted noncausal fact-to-bearer extension. T19 adds its affirmative, defeasible common-source appraisal for the actual productively connected field under separate nonduplication, source-mode, mediation and field premises. Later coordinating reservations are dated appraisals, not revisions of what those reports said. None of these philosophical acceptances is converted into a kernel theorem by placing it in a dependency graph. [F250RM44, §§Result and scope, A–C]

The reconstruction's anchored-incidence alternative was a proposed design: shared real requisites could carry a fixed qualified source's coverage through a connected field, with nonduplication adding uniqueness. It required sound represented use and, separately, visibility of every actual contributor; arbitrary bundles and omitted history could not satisfy its intended application. The later typed bridge and incidence proofs supply their own completed conditional results in §§3 and10.2. The original design's NOT_ATTEMPTED status is therefore historical. Its demand for a faithful refinement into independently interpreted Sixth ancestry, preserving every incoming branch and relating requisites to all-ancestor coverage, remains a separate obligation rather than being discharged by renaming both predicates “complete.” [F250RM44, §§Readiness for the next stage, Anchored propagation alternative for review, Faithful incidence and original contributor visibility]

<a id="second-cohort-source-character-and-scope"></a>

### 12.21 Character evidence, practical assurance and the scope of the formal joins

The source-relative affirmative account has three distinct forms of support. The received *Asfahani* addendum reports an argument from eligible original perfection and giver-priority on printed pp.127–129; acquired recognition of truthful character through interaction, testing, converging testimony and contextual indicators on pp.206–210; and mercy, wisdom and divine custom inferred from beneficial order and patterns of governance on pp.221–223. These are substantive arguments. A critic who grants only bare information or occasional useful output has not granted their conclusions and cannot present that weaker starting point as the whole source position. Conversely, identifying an argument in a source does not independently establish every empirical example or its philosophical bridge. [S250F370]

Character recognition here is not a frequency count promoted into certainty. The text distinguishes lying from error, allows contextual knowledge of a normally unreliable speaker's particular true report, and rejects treating an abstract imagined alternative as evidence that the alternative occurred. Its own descriptions of necessary or unassailable knowledge must not be rewritten as merely tentative statistical confidence. That epistemic strength also must not be silently enlarged into the different modal proposition that this individual's every eligible assertion is true at every metaphysically possible circumstance. Ordinary warranted testimony, the trustworthiness of this particular assurance and essential all-context veracity have different burdens. The practical-perfection argument above supplies reasons relevant to the stronger claim; ordinary testimonial knowledge need not wait for a proof of that universal essence. [S250F370, §§1–2]

The source's criticism of a Muʿtazilite chain on pp.219–220 concerns an interconnected argument with its consequences for attributes and acts. It does not warrant attributing rejection of every shared judgment that lying or unjust validation is a defect. The middle account reported on pp.225–227 preserves intrinsic character, wisdom in command and real acts without accepting either the criticized package or unrestricted voluntarism. The addendum also reports *al-Nubuwwāt* 9, hosted line106, as positively connecting complete apprehension of the fitting course with willing it. This supports the affirmative account's actual premise rather than proving its independent force against every lucid mixed-agency hypothesis. The hypothesized one-betrayal rival must answer independently manifested character and the source's stronger perfection argument; merely adding an exception to every regularity is additional explanatory structure, not a demonstrated evidential tie. [S250F370, §§1.4–2]

A decision-time distinction remains exact. If certification is at t₀, irreversible intervention at t₁ and exposure of falsehood at t₂, the order t₀<t₁<t₂ is compatible with eventual exposure. Later genuine corrective knowledge neither turns the earlier false belief into knowledge nor reverses an irreversible outcome. This does **not** refute present character evidence or the separate preventive claim that mercy and wisdom exclude supplying an incontestable validating sign to a liar. Nor is “every lie is corrected for its victim in time” attributed verbatim to the source. An uncontested sign today is not thereby incontestable in the relevant stronger sense. The local question is which warrant covers the particular safety proposition through the intervention interval, not whether all testimonial knowledge fails. [S250F370, §3]

The king's deliberate matching sign in the reported pp.228–230 example strongly supports intentional confirmation and public assurance. Confirmation of a descriptive proposition and its truth remain distinct unless integrity or an appropriate truth-making act supplies the bridge. A competent king's valid appointment may constitute the envoy's **present** status. It does not thereby constitute a claimed earlier commission or the distinct causal proposition that a repair root stays safe through intervention. The latter could be made true by actual repair or effective governing control, but that exercise and interval coverage require evidence. The example is presented as a route of specified Ashʿarite/Juwaynian figures; the continuation on p.231 allows miracles and other routes to prophecy. Neither blanket personal endorsement of every reported clause nor blanket repudiation is inferred. The addendum's *Nubuwwāt* comparison locates the king-sign route within an explicit integrity/purpose setting. [S250F370, §4]

**Source custody and exact reading credit.** These are inherited findings from the English *A Commentary on the Creed of Asfahani*, v2.3(2). The addendum reports full reading of printed pp.127–129, 206–210 and 218–230, additional checks of pp.231–235, and visual comparison of rendered pp.223 and229; printed page n corresponds there to one-based PDF page n+7. Its anomalous p.229 clause was confirmed in that rendering and not silently emended. This consolidation claims no new PDF redistribution, Arabic collation or primary reading. A separate received-volume scope record reports42 first-pass receipts,2548 electronic lines and94,952 whitespace-delimited words, matched by boundary anchors to printed body positions3–604 of the Ḥusayn b.ʿUkāsha2020 layout. Its reflection is12 windows/241 distinct lines plus21 selected scan pages, not a second full traversal. That correspondence does not establish apparatus identity; preliminary matter and indexes are excluded and the historically incomplete work remains incomplete. The edition and transcription limitations survive condensation. [S250F370, §§1,4.2,6] [S250F406]

The separate **volume-two** record for original *al-Ṣawāʿiq* must not be merged with the preceding volume-one scope. It reports one complete continuous reading of its assigned electronic body, followed by eight bounded reflective rereads: source002 lines 1010–1350, source003 lines 16–1192 and source004 lines 16–362, matched by supplied boundaries to printed 605–1143. The recorded totals are 1,865 lines, 486,181 Unicode characters and 91,150 whitespace-delimited words, including structural markers. The record distinguishes the affirmative arguments and premise scrutiny from any target-driven conclusion; this edition acquires the study record, not another reading of those primary characters. [F939-C938]

Its textual custody qualifications remain material. The original is incompletely preserved: nominal 242 faces/234 extant, a possible omission or numbering error at 48–49, and lacunae at 73–78. Restoration at printed 1111–1113 and some repairs at 1037–1038 come from the abridgment auxiliary م, not independently surviving original text. Limited visual coverage and the absence of complete critical-edition collation remain explicit. Neither missing later principal polemics nor present external-URL availability is supplied by this scope record. These limits constrain attribution without erasing the recorded positive study or extending selected passages to the whole tradition. [F939-C938]

#### Exact local consequences do not replace the substantive premises

The two modal production lemmas sharpen, rather than restart, §12.20. At any relevant circumstance, retained entire original provision of some contribution and a whole-receipt-to-distinct-complete-overlap premise contradict CND. Conversely, given that overlap clause, whole receipt excludes retention of an original role. The same contribution need not be fixed across circumstances. The two-world switching assignment retains necessary existence, standing power, actual nonreceipt and exercised efficacy, while original provenance changes and the second-world exercise becomes derived. Even its overlap conditional holds because its retained-original-role antecedent is absent there. It tests the missing role-invariance premise, not the metaphysical realizability of such a source. A separate token-reception assignment retains original role while denying whole reception. The bounded research specification expressly preserves the earlier affirmative T17 constitutive appraisal; this production-only investigation is not a revival of its superseded weaker verdict. [S250F251] [S250F345]

The broader same-bearer result can dispense with binary receipt representation: Completion, Realisation, same-respect SupportTransport, contingency-as-need and constitutive reception suffice for one actual relevant resource/bearer with necessity and essential whole-nonreceipt. The independent scope controls exhibit a distinct binary relation with existing endpoints that fails to represent whole receipt, so binary UniformRoot then need not follow. They also supply two disjoint productive fields, each with a necessary original and a contingent received effect, without a common bearer for every target. Finally, an empty target-occurrence predicate can satisfy the remaining universal premises while supplying no original bearer. These are nonvacuity and interpretation checks, not grounds for deleting the positive occurrence premise or the actual philosophical argument. Witness-local versions consume only their selected support, need and backward-transfer instances; a conclusion-equivalent local transfer acquires no new independent warrant by restatement. [S250F337]

The generic reception formalization records why fixed-origin transport is stronger than generic receipt: with existing targets the former implies the latter, but the latter permits a different supplier at another circumstance. It even allows opposite subordinate dependence edges at different worlds, though the displayed actual graphs are acyclic. That modal-union pattern is not an actual causal cycle. Generic receipt alone also permits the actual root's absence elsewhere; contingency-as-need supplies the separate necessity step. The adjoining-root implementation preserves old tuples and old-endpoint paths exactly, optional acyclicity and ancestry well-foundedness, and actual coverage. New actual-root uniqueness is not all-world uniqueness; grounding necessitation and existing added targets require necessary old actual roots. Assigning standing capacity Q to the new root changes whether it is a holder, not whether it has an actual productive edge. The construction is structural, not a proof of a metaphysically eligible rival. [S250F309] [S250F330] [S250F492]

Finite solo ability is likewise distinct from the source-mode premise. A three-history assignment gives g and h genuine solo-production witnesses in different nonactual histories, while the actual occurrence consists of g's first piece and h's second piece. Every same-world contribution respects CND, yet neither is the actual solo provider. Contribution identity includes its history, target and piece; matching an outcome label across histories does not identify the concrete token. The deliberately false actual-solo claim is an expected rejection control, not a fresh compiler result. [S250F318] [S250F268]

The exact veracity map retains the positive controlled-token argument and its global coverage extension, the no-counterfeit equivalence at its separate factivity scope, and nonempty true source-owned speech alongside false created speech. Its six removal models distinguish K, weak awareness/control, defect classification D, all-context exclusion N and actual practical conformance P. Weak A/C omissions are not countermodels to a full source profile. Strong informed ownership may be nonempty and still contain a known false assertion when N is omitted; truth is not obtained by redefining ownership. Conversely, truthfulness does not imply generic practical conformance. The short failed-converse target is therefore retained as a specified negative test, not a new metaphysical counterexample. [S250F295] [S250F311]

The joint finite map gives the same designated g across the resource, field and veracity interfaces, with actual nonempty productive reachability, a complete selected incoming inventory and a genuinely distinct received false speaker. It retains an outside necessary original, a contingent target and an unauthenticated token. Thus same-field coverage does not authenticate a message or eliminate every outside being. The additional negative targets test omission of original use, invisible anchors, incomplete requisite inventory, CND without coverage, field-local versus unrestricted CND, and source provision without message authentication. They do not supply observed failure logs or independently executed model searches. The origination controls separately reject classifying every renewed original act as created or treating a potential effect label as actual existence. [S250F425] [S250F360] [S250F388] [S250F426] [S250F471] [S250F490] [S250F442] [S250F419] [S250F436]

The original-bearer rejected targets separately attempt an original bearer without Completion, Realisation or SupportTransport, necessity without contingency-as-need, and binary uniform roothood without constitutive reception. Their source specifies compiler sanity targets against inherited controls, not a new exhaustive search. [S250F436]

<a id="second250-source-model-chronology"></a>

The cross-stream case record clarifies how these earned results relate to source study. It documents same-bearer transport, productive role-invariance, coverage before uniqueness, real received agency, veracity's fittingness premise and support distinct from assertion ownership as separate dependencies. Later *Shifāʾ*, *Miftāḥ* and *Ṣafadiyya* contexts can improve interpretation of already constructed typed models without becoming the historical cause of their construction or a new joint theorem. The sign/custody/scoped-delegation returns are substantive contextual checks, but the proposed special token-authentication transfer was not implemented. Retrospective alignment, source-guided design, an actual question-triggered return and a completed new source–theorem–source cycle retain different credit. [S250B-025, lines 7–65](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/182829543432a0f771f552f74cb3bc2896e5b7e536c0e93bac231b0a3935aef8/CROSS_STREAM_CASES.md#L7-L65) [S250B-025, lines 79–101](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/182829543432a0f771f552f74cb3bc2896e5b7e536c0e93bac231b0a3935aef8/CROSS_STREAM_CASES.md#L79-L101) [S250B-025, lines 127–137](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/182829543432a0f771f552f74cb3bc2896e5b7e536c0e93bac231b0a3935aef8/CROSS_STREAM_CASES.md#L127-L137) [S250B-027, lines 51–121](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/1aedc48f3e7507cb0f14921fcd0905c1f7a89137ed8cabb5450a316903635219/ARABIC_READING_METHOD.md#L51-L121)

Two mathematical cases illustrate the practical importance of that discipline. The copied-trace experiment preserves its exact positive-copy total variation 1/4 and equal-prior success bound 5/8; it samples once and copies the realized trace, not fresh independent observations. The alias-cut example must retain all inclusion-minimal cuts before quotienting: for supports {a₁}, {a₂,b}, {a₃,b} with the a-labels sharing one root, the larger three-label cut yields the true one-root cut that a cheapest-label-first policy discards. Those results are substantively integrated in the information-and-inquiry owner, not derived from an Arabic speech/carrier passage or reexecuted here. Their source-identity and actual-independence applications still need evidence. Likewise, exact grounded retraction preserves claim meaning and rule scope; historical bytes do not themselves certify unchanged applicability. [S250B-025, lines 67–77](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/182829543432a0f771f552f74cb3bc2896e5b7e536c0e93bac231b0a3935aef8/CROSS_STREAM_CASES.md#L67-L77) [S250B-025, lines 103–125](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/182829543432a0f771f552f74cb3bc2896e5b7e536c0e93bac231b0a3935aef8/CROSS_STREAM_CASES.md#L103-L125) [S250B-027, lines 123–145](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/blob/a7ff0e33d1a299db640041c46b1af81ca70851f6/experiments/orthemology-v5-successors/source-store/1aedc48f3e7507cb0f14921fcd0905c1f7a89137ed8cabb5450a316903635219/ARABIC_READING_METHOD.md#L123-L145)

The historical pre-formal register remains an obligation map, not a later falsification of these earned results. Its questions cover resource realisation and whole-bearer transport; contingency, constitutive receipt and modal domain; local ancestor coverage and connectedness; same-respect contribution individuation and complete source mode; faithful mediation, actual role and visibility; same-witness joins; practical integrity, assertion attribution and recipient authentication; and inhabited consistency. Entries marked “not attempted” described that register's stage. Subsequent positive theorems and controls above retain their own narrower completion evidence, while the unrestricted philosophical and representation burdens still require their actual arguments. A listed potential test is not an executed negative result. [S250F434]

The exact veracity control body directly supports the distinctions just made. Besides the K/D/N/P deletion witnesses, its awareness/control examples explicitly use weaker signatures and do not preserve full omniscience or independently warranted genuine ownership. Its positive package contains true source-owned speech and a distinct created false assertion which is not thereby the source's own assertion. `Acceptance` applies the positive veracity and informed-ownership awareness/control interfaces; its other `#check` lines remain readback requests. [R750A-543] [R750A-540]

The two small files asserting veracity after deleting K or P target precisely the negated conclusions displayed in that body. Likewise `strong_truth_implies_weak_truth` asks for `Veracity localGlobal false`, whereas the admitted `VeracityBoundary.Controls.local_global_separation` and `VeracityBoundary.Controls.strong_ownership_noncollapse` expressly state its negation and distinguish the restricted informed-ownership assertion domain. This resolves the small file's **source-level intended target** without resolving which imported bytes a particular build uses or claiming a newly executed failure. No control here withdraws the affirmative Knowledge, ownership and practical-conformance argument with its substantive premises. [R750A-513] [R750A-526] [R750A-579]

`ModalCapacityControl` adds a nonvacuous structural discriminator: a necessary unique support root genuinely exercises capacity at another modal index on a new effect, while actual production of the old effect remains holder→effect and there is no actual productive ancestry from the root to that effect. It preserves old existence, productive/support facts and capacity through the displayed embedding. This is not a metaphysically certified rival or an unrestricted perfection interpretation. The field-enlargement file only requests `FieldCND expanded` through an imported tactic; the separated-field global-coverage and conformance-without-classification files explicitly request false strengthenings. They retain the actual connectedness, field scope and classification duties, not new positive coverage or classification theorems. [R750A-519] [R750A-538] [R750A-539] [R750A-541]

## 13. Conclusion

The received-actuality argument establishes a relevant actual original under its defended productive interpretation, and the intrinsic-adequacy argument concerns the necessity of that same bearer. Original unity requires further work: differentiated actual efficacy, the fitting mode of complete original provision, faithful mediation and the genuine connected field. These contributions are compatible and cumulative, but their premises are not interchangeable. Local nonduplication gives at most one entire attribution; it does not create a complete provider. Connectivity propagates warranted coverage; it does not generate it.

The resulting source-unity appraisal remains affirmative and defeasible at the actual connected-field scope. The strongest collective-grounding, brute-original and harmonious-plural proposals challenge different judgments. Their genuine explanatory or structural credits must survive, together with the reasons the retained appraisal finds insufficient for parity. The conditional proofs establish their stated inferences; they neither replace philosophical warrant nor certify every semantic application. Generic explanatory-fact uniqueness and complete centered knowledge supply no silent bridge to a unique original bearer.

The separately affirmative essential-independence judgment also retains its inherited constitutive scope. The bounded necessity argument neither retracts that result nor independently establishes it by repeating a necessity proof; the later alternative productive route is distinct from its original rationale. [Intrinsic necessity: restored result and bounded operation decision, §§1–2][s7]

The remaining questions are substantive: how complete original efficacy applies to a proposed primitive joint manifestation; how source individuation and actual requisite coverage are independently warranted; and what grounds a wider mastery or disconnected-domain conclusion. Those questions preserve the established actual-field result without expanding it into an unrestricted theorem. The synthesis does not alter accepted editions, supply new owner adoption, or claim that editorial unification is a new scientific discovery.


The attribute extension retains an affirmative philosophical account of original cognition, comprehensive Knowledge, informed agency and practical integrity. Its exact conditional proofs distinguish actual from standing cognition, complete productive determination from generic capacity, and source-owned truthfulness from authenticated reception. Wisdom and disclosure can enter a connected positive explanation when their substantive premises are preserved. The operational comparison further shows why knowing a true corrective target and securing an effective intervention require different evidence. These results consolidate the source arguments without presenting their weaker-premise controls as refutations of the stronger account.


### Eight received studies: arguments and dated appraisal limits

<a id="foundation250-eight-study-appraisals"></a>

These eight received studies contribute different parts of the argument developed above. They are not eight independent historical witnesses or eight votes for one conclusion. Darʾ and Minhāj were studied in selected volumes, while the other records state their own received-body selections and textual limits. The following guide preserves their substantive differences and the chronology of their judgments. It incorporates the authored appraisals, not another reading of the Arabic books, a new scan collation or a new proof execution. The detailed source controls below remain part of their interpretation.

<a id="foundation250-dar-appraisal"></a>

**Darʾ, selected volumes 8–9.** The reflection argues that original explanation includes originating and sustaining the substances, properties and capacities involved, rather than merely moving, commanding or serving as an object of love. Its nonduplication account distinguishes differentiated cooperative contributions from two complete producers of the same numerical product. The remaining transfer questions concern act individuation, unilateral efficacy and whether a joint product's dependence is also intrinsic dependence of its producers. An agent's own successive acts can be conditions without an independently supplying other. Logical premise order also need not reproduce the human order of discovery: a later argument can confirm earlier knowledge without having produced it. The recorded selected rereads are not a full second traversal or a final global warrant judgment. [RM-DAR]

<a id="foundation250-minhaj-appraisal"></a>

**Minhāj, selected volumes 2–3.** The appraisal credits a substantive necessary-bearer and pure-perfection argument, then a further argument from realized efficacy and interconnected products toward complete sourcehood. Necessary harmony and foreknowledge are expressly considered; their explanatory role cannot be settled by either calling every concomitance causal donation or treating the word harmony as a complete explanation. Intrinsic creating and an external created product remain distinct. For attestation, intentional certification and a truthful certifying source are separate premises, and accurate access to the asserted content is another. The 7 October study-stage judgment strengthens the affirmative case without declaring every source-mode bridge settled. Its electronic coordinates are not certified printed pagination. [RM-MINHAJ]

<a id="foundation250-sawaiq-appraisal"></a>

**The received original al-Ṣawāʿiq.** The appraisal credits positive perfection, giver-priority, strict unsurpassable highestness and complete dominion as genuine arguments, stronger than merely denying conflict. Their applicability to every proposed original bearer still needs warrant. Responsive acts can express prior perfection without an outsider supplying a missing constitutive excellence. Bearer, attribute, act and created product are not interchangeable. The selected original transcript is complete at its received boundary, while the historical original is incomplete. It is not al-Mawṣilī's abridgment: identified wording repaired from that auxiliary, including the 1037–1038 contrast and 1111–1113 restoration, retains that provenance rather than becoming independently surviving original text. The recorded modern volume seam and incomplete critical collation remain distinct from the argument's force. [RM-SAWAIQ]

<a id="foundation250-shifa-appraisal"></a>

**Shifāʾ al-ʿAlīl.** Real created powers, receptive subjects, conditions and impediments form the source's positive causal account; divine creating does not erase the creature's genuine act. Wise ends and appropriately timed exercise express antecedent perfection rather than acquisition of missing divine capacity. Ordered cooperation across heterogeneous agents provides positive common-source evidence. At this study's earlier cutoff, before Miftāḥ, Nubuwwāt and Ṣafadiyya, that strengthened case still did not remove its withheld sufficient common-source verdict. The unresolved transfer was from foreign completion of a product to defect in every proposed original contributor's fitting exercise. The e232 transition remains textually incomplete, and no inaccessible scan supplies the omitted consequence. These limits preserve the surrounding affirmative argument, not a refutation of it or a revision of the later assessment. [RM-SHIFA]

<a id="foundation250-jami-appraisal"></a>

**Jāmiʿ al-Masāʾil, sixth collection.** Standing ability to act alone differs from actually producing the whole alone in this event. The source grants the former to some cooperators and argues that the latter's inhibition conflicts with complete divinity; that ranking is substantive, not a consequence of the word cooperation. Each participant can retain power, awareness and intention while the achieved end requires their joint acts. Reciprocal conditions need not be reciprocal original donation. The recorded readers agree about those local distinctions but differ over sufficient actual-common-source warrant: the middle reader provisionally favors the unified explanation, while the first reader withholds sufficient discrimination from this collection alone. The difference remains an attributed assessment, not a vote or a whole-corpus verdict. Eighteen received pieces, abridgments and incomplete endings do not become one historically complete monograph. [RM-JAMI]

<a id="foundation250-miftah-appraisal"></a>

**Miftāḥ Dār al-Saʿāda.** Knowledge, will, power, acquired habit, recipient fitness and impediment do separate work: later damage to cognition does not erase earlier genuine recognition. Relational goods and fitting new acts need not repair a maker's lack. Real created causality and compound outcomes coexist with the common-Creator argument. The equal-opposition discussion has a narrower unresolved burden: exclusion of two fully sufficient contrary causes does not automatically exclude equal partial tendencies or every zero resultant. The source's priority claim about producing versus inhibiting needs its own warrant. The whole received study includes apparatus and historical natural-history material; those illustrations receive no fresh empirical certification. Nor does received-body completion supply the promised fuller treatment of will that the historical work left incomplete. [RM-MIFTAH]

<a id="foundation250-nubuwwat-appraisal"></a>

**Al-Nubuwwāt.** Knowing purposive agency, wise guidance and intentional certification provide a positive attestation account, not simply an inference from unusual events. The ring/envoy analysis requires both source provenance and a certifying purpose; theft, repair or a strong rival explanation can defeat that inference. Certification of a mission does not certify every later statement. Mediation is compatible with source-owned communication, while generic productive causation alone does not identify an assertion or approved mission. Multiple rational and testimonial routes remain possible; repeated transmission is not automatically independent testimony. At its Nubuwwāt-stage boundary the appraisal credits these arguments but has not independently established every narrated event, its exact certification or complete numerical Creatorhood. Later Ṣafadiyya study and the final comparative judgment remain separate. [RM-NUBUWWAT]

<a id="foundation250-safadiyya-appraisal"></a>

**Al-Ṣafadiyya.** The appraisal's central gain is typed explanation: efficient maker, receptive condition, intrinsic attribute, conceptual component, end and evidential sign have different roles. Establishing a necessary existent does not alone identify the Maker. Giver-priority is positive perfection reasoning with eligibility and bearer-appropriate mode retained; a creaturely excellence is not transferred indiscriminately. An active Creator, determinate successive acts and real dependent creaturely efficacy belong to the affirmative account. Multiple epistemic routes and audience-sensitive arguments remain available, but reading a prophetic-sign argument does not establish its historical antecedents. The full selected electronic sequence and bounded newer-edition controls do not amount to complete scan or manuscript collation. Consequential corrections and quoted versus authorial voices remain material to interpretation. [RM-SAFADIYYA]

<a id="foundation250-earlier-actual-order-appraisal"></a>

**The earlier actual-order assessment.** The separate 7 October assessment made before Miftāḥ, Nubuwwāt and Ṣafadiyya positively favored one complete Creator of the actual connected order but withheld sufficient numerical-authorship warrant. It retained the substantive original-bearer and positive-agency starting point. Its objection was that integrated coordination appeared to distinguish unity from unrelated production more strongly than from intrinsically wise, concordant plural contributions; an organizer is also not automatically the complete original provider. It neither certified plural metaphysical possibility nor inferred its actual-order verdict solely from failure of universal SourceMode. Its selected reinspection and partial-unblinding limits remain historical. The later affirmative actual-field reassessment changes the weighting of positive reasons without rewriting this earlier dissent. [RM-ACTUAL]

<a id="foundation250-earlier-universal-appraisal"></a>

**The earlier universal-source assessment.** The principal appraisal, before its later Shifāʾ controls, withheld sufficient warrant that every qualified original must provide every requisite of the connected product. It credited complete existential adequacy, concrete original agency, realized efficacy and the stronger strict-supremacy argument. Its unresolved transitions were from a voluntarily partial undertaking to intrinsic deficiency and from unborrowed perfection to eligible domination over every proposed necessary peer. A complete-account target and an original bearer witness do not already identify one bearer owning every contribution. The later Shifāʾ control and addendum are separately dated studies, as the chronology above records; they strengthen the positive reconstruction without removing that reservation. This judgment is distinct both from the earlier actual-order withholding and from later provisional actual-common-source assent. No formal conditional or failed rival model substitutes for the relevant positive philosophical warrant. [RM-UNIVERSAL]

### The received study bodies and their interpretive boundaries

The added Darʾ–Minhāj records are authored studies of selected electronic bodies, not republication or new reading of the books. Their historical completion is specific: *Darʾ* 8 records 1,873 paragraphs and 91,341 whitespace words; *Darʾ* 9 records source014:940–956, 015:20–802 and 016:20–1092, with 82,711 words. *Minhāj* 2 records 437 local lines and 85,369 words; volume 3 records 424 lines and 67,886 words. Their bounded overlapping reflections are not extra unique first-pass coverage or whole second traversals. Stable local coordinates are not certified print pagination. Matching electronic openings and colophons establish the selected boundaries, not a clean critical edition, complete apparatus or manuscript collation. Denied witnesses supplied no silent repair. [F250-C012] [F250-C066]

The received *Miftāḥ* body is main electronic 3–1603, with 1,601 positions and 334,183 words including the supplied apparatus, plus 103 preliminary positions and 15,224 words. Its original reflections cover 71 distinct main positions; a separate 100-position reinspection overlaps in 23, giving a union of 148, not 171. The reported 53-position visual supplement includes 21 manuscript reproductions that were only partly deciphered overall; it is not a 1,998-page scan reading. The edition's electronic three-part labels do not establish physical binding seams. Completion of this received body also does not supply the promised conceptual treatment of will that the historical work left incomplete. [F250-C188]

Voice and counter-evidence remain integral to interpretation. In the final *Miftāḥ* division, ʿĪsā's claim that choice requires access to every contrary is rejected at 1243; quoted philosophical disdain for practical benefit is not the author's conclusion. Main 1512–1515 positively affirms genuine created action, acquisition and choice, and 1590–1593 rejects both independent created efficacy and causal erasure. The criticism of selective memory for correct predictions at 1565–1566 also applies to favored anecdotes. The modern correction at 1447 defeats the specific no-meeting objection to a reported chain without proving astrology. The tension between bodily-physiognomic judgments and the condemnation of mistreating a one-eyed person is retained as historical counterpressure, never a method for judging people. Modern annotations and electronic second-edition additions remain distinct from authorial text. [F250-C014] [F250-C075] [F250-C115]

The reported blank at main 811, the two-and-a-half-line manuscript blank noted at 1595 and the unresolved apparent missing negation at 1599 are inherited witness limitations, not omitted reading windows or invitations to invent restored wording. Selected scan checks reportedly confirmed the relevant defects; reading these study records does not repeat those checks. Their historical scientific, medical, sectarian and legal examples are attributed source material, not newly validated science or present guidance. [F250-C075] [F250-C188]

Their physical, philological and transmission premises are not newly authenticated, and the focused causal review is not treated as independently endorsing those contextual programmes. These do not constitute complete readings of those works, a new scan or manuscript collation, fresh verification of inherited page mappings, or endorsement of their historical physical examples. The comprehensive-Knowledge study owns its printed X, 150–152 control; the veracity crosscheck owns its reported earlier document readings. This continuation reads their admitted public bodies, not the private or otherwise unavailable originals they reference.


<a id="joint-bridge-selected-formal-source-scope"></a>

The contribution-incidence source already explained in §10.2 and the literal joint-model, joining, acceptance and rejected-claim sources now discussed in §10.21 are retained as complete immutable formal artifacts through the public commit-pinned links below. The same retention applies to the eleven selected fixtures in §10.2. Their whole bodies, including definitions, every quantified declaration and proof, finite-type instances, configuration options, imports, tactic implementations, comments and API checks, remain recoverable at those links; this prose does not replace them as executable modules. Exact size, SHA-256 and native Git blob identities were rechecked for the selected bodies before incorporation. This bounded reading did not traverse their other imported modules or rerun Lean. It supplies no fresh positive-test result, expected-red diagnostic, independently executed model review, full metaphysical interpretation, authentication or adoption. The explicit changed-model counterexamples in §10.21 are distinguished from mere expected-failure fixture declarations.

<a id="productive-origination-correction-boundary"></a>

The productive-origination preservation guide confirms the narrow correction history already stated in this appendix: the field/member relevance correction was resolved without withdrawing the foundational judgment, but the initial report's exact bytes were overwritten before a snapshot and were not recovered. A retained initial manifest and receipt do not supply a reproducible original draft or an exact historical diff. The root reading note is participating context, distinct from the separate independent review. The guide's portable identity checks do not rerun the earlier scholarly judgment, the original fifty-seven-check review or excluded primary-source inspections. These are additional source-scope bindings for the existing argument, not a new proof or a reconstruction of missing text. [GUIDE105-G054]


<a id="f250-a-textual-and-reading-controls"></a>

### The two received reading dossiers and their consequential controls

This incorporation reads the forty-four admitted public report bodies, not the primary Arabic books anew. Their sequential notes, range appraisals, joins, later scan controls and final appraisals are distinct stages. In *al-Nubuwwāt* the reported received traversal covers 101,419 words and 436 electronic records in fifty-one windows; the opening receipt expressly includes a repaired display and the final receipt does not claim a whole printed apparatus reading. Sixty-seven selected authorial or locator-page views and thirteen modern-index views are distinct from forty-eight acquisition/bibliographical receipts. Its three website sections are not three printed volumes; four contiguous reading assignments divide that same received body. The al-Tuwayyān edition is reported as two volumes, first 1420/2000, with 1,198 merged PDF positions. Its editor reports one manuscript and uses two earlier prints eclectically; these are not three independent manuscript witnesses. Ten announced indexes versus four received indexes concerns the modern apparatus and does not establish missing authorial chapters. [F250-A097-1-3] [F250-A026-1-3] [F250-A133-1-13] [F250-A226-1-47] [F250-A220-9-53] [F250-A070-1-38]

For *al-Ṣafadiyya*, the received four electronic sections contain 119,021 words and 1,947 records traversed in eighty-five windows and joined across five adjacent ranges. The internal electronic colophon/title at S002L239–241 is absent from the reported printed 303–304 transition; the authorial ending and the following attribution colophon also remain separate. The Adwāʾ/Dār Ibn Ḥazm edition is first 1423/2002, with editors Sayyid ibn ʿAbbās **al-Julaymī**, with jīm, and Ayman ibn ʿĀrif al-Dimashqī. The apparatus describes the Selim Ağa, Pertev Paşa 358 manuscript also used by Rashād Sālim, not a newly independent manuscript tradition. Alleged authorial marginal handwriting, ownership and reconstructed order remain editorial reports. Thirty-nine modern pages, a ninety-four-item correction catalogue, selected body controls and partial manuscript plates do not constitute full diplomatic collation or complete reading of an acquired second edition. [F250-A162-3-50] [F250-A191-1-48] [F250-A040-1-27] [F250-A098-1-6]

The inferentially consequential variants must accompany the arguments they control. In *Ṣafadiyya*, printed 78 restores the successive-preparation discussion obscured by a duplicated electronic sentence. At 105 the controlled **يقضي بأنه مقدوره** concerns power, not the electronic duration reading; the catalogue's **يقتضي** is not identical to the body reading. At 106 the catalogue and body agree on **لا أن**, so the earlier alleged conflict was a provisional-transcription error, although the electronic **إلا أن** and surrounding syntax still need care. At 122 the omitted positive description of perfection is restored by the reported print. At 169 the bracketed **[لا]** reverses the apparent ground concerning the impossibility of continuous events. At 172 real acquisition is restored against the electronic denial, and at 197 the conceded ordinary event-kind must not be lost when distinguishing extraordinary causal reach. [F250-A062-13-89] [F250-A127-17-81] [F250-A098-100-115]

Further controls affect the same causal and semantic distinctions: printed 469 has **without** the bearer's events rather than **with all** its events; 473 has sharing rather than stipulating; 477 restores the self-subsisting-bearer clause; 485 concerns external rather than merely mental realities; 531 concerns definitions rather than origination; and 539 concerns action rather than intellect. The study leaves several hard readings unresolved rather than selecting the version most convenient for a proof. The apparent universal-negation problem at 178 and triangle wording at 426 persist in print. The phrase at 534 rendered “an accident subsisting in itself” also persists, and “in his soul” is a contextual interpretation, not a demonstrated corruption. Catalogue/body discrepancies at entries S23, S38, S39 and L05 preclude treating the catalogue as an automatic substitute for the controlled body. [F250-A069-15-95] [F250-A030-9-64] [F250-A098-100-115] [F250-A145-25-90]

The *Nubuwwāt* control at 322 is incorporated in §1. Other controls clarify the referent of the love discussion at 359, preserve rather than repair the anomalous negative at 537 and abrupt consensus-to-envoy transition at 594, and distinguish the author's garden discussion at 704–709 from a modern note quoting a differently attributed position. No chronology or harmonization is invented. At the token passage the edited wording and reported manuscript repetition reinforce the suspension rule, while editorial choices remain visible. The 1067–1068 join likewise is not treated as fully restored merely because an editor supplies a bracketed connector. These are local textual findings, not a certificate that every unexamined sentence is sound. [F250-A160-1-33] [F250-A089-1-32] [F250-A011-1-75] [F250-A175-1-21] [F250-A216-1-19]

<a id="f250-a-broader-source-portrait"></a>

The broader reading remains philosophically relevant even where it adds no new source-mode theorem. The *Nubuwwāt* dossiers retain the difference between knowledge and mere assertion; public accusation and private counsel; sincere error and deliberate fraud; prophet-kings and servant-messengers; inspiration and commissioned prophecy; time-bounded landmarks; language competence in claims of stylistic inimitability; and “Torah” as sometimes wider than the Pentateuch. The *Ṣafadiyya* dossiers retain speech and recitation, created measures and the scope of decree, cosmic transformation and resurrection, practical and affective fulfilment, changing laws, source criticism and justice toward opponents. Severe historical group judgments and juridical or supernatural narratives remain attributed material, not new historical verification, medical guidance or present legal prescriptions. This matters to interpretation: the author concedes genuine natural and mathematical knowledge, some ethical improvement, truth within criticized arguments and excusable error after serious effort. Such concessions prevent the polemical descriptions from being flattened into a denial of every secondary cause, every rational method or every opponent's sincerity. [F250-A010-1-53] [F250-A024-63-96] [F250-A063-1-15] [F250-A036-89-113] [F250-A055-28-36] [F250-A067-375-391] [F250-A067-767-781] [F250-A067-833-845] [F250-A169-71-103]

The guide's wider comparisons with *Darʾ*, *Minhāj*, *al-Ṣawāʿiq*, *Shifāʾ*, *Jāmiʿ* and *Miftāḥ* are report-level connections to the source distinctions already developed in §§2, 9 and 12: proof versus compulsory learning sequence, maker versus preserver, realized efficacy versus borrowed capacity, intrinsic qualification versus later act, genuinely mediated accomplishment and completing a product versus perfecting its maker. They do not make those works newly read primary sources in this incorporation or independent votes for its conclusion. The specialist questions remain substantive obligations: identify the actual bearer and relevant product, justify passage from product-need to an agent's defect, test a principled necessarily harmonious rival, and establish an attestation's source, content and nondeceptive purpose. Exact source citation and custody settle neither those philosophical issues nor the historical truth of every report. [F250-A100-15-337] [F250-A073-1-77] [F250-A195-1-31]

The guide adds precise qualifications to that cross-reference. Its *Aṣbahāniyya* union is 228 distinct PDF positions, including two apparatus-only positions, rather than another whole-volume reading; the editor marks main 399–450 as a single-witness addition and main 412 retains a possible missing negation. Three studies of the same *Akmaliyya* answer are not three independent witnesses, and the electronic repeated negation at 6:95 remains unrepaired. The English Oneness comparison distinguishes extracted pages from selected images, while the *al-Dāʾ wa-l-dawāʾ* comparisons contain twenty-six observations of twenty-three distinct positions. The Richard of St Victor comparison is limited to the stated selections, with III.10 unclaimed and translation ancestry not independently certified. These are reported scope controls, not fresh receipt of those objects. In *Miftāḥ*, the secondary reconstruction at main 966, absent numbered argument at 993 and note-only parallel at 1284 are additional reasons not to normalize the received text silently or treat supplied electronic second-edition addenda as printed third-edition wording. [F250-A100-15-41] [F250-A100-333-337]

<a id="f250-a-source-correspondence"></a>

The bounded opening and continuation appraisals support the *Nubuwwāt* synthesis above at their own local scopes; they do not supersede its whole received-body appraisal or the later common-source judgment. The shorter return notes and verification statements establish what the earlier readers actually revisited, not additional independent confirmations of the same proposition. [F250-A118-1-99] [F250-A024-1-96] [F250-A063-1-15] [F250-A086-1-105] [F250-A172-1-41] [F250-A216-1-19] [F250-A175-1-21] [F250-A133-1-13] [F250-A226-1-47]

The five *Ṣafadiyya* range appraisals and their controlled-page companions similarly preserve the continuous progression: the necessary concrete bearer and positive attributes, real secondary efficacy and anti-reduction argument, successive original agency and scope of conditions, common creation and causal individuation, then knowledge, love, worship and the final predicate partition. The joins reconcile unfinished arguments across received range boundaries instead of treating the local stopping statements as final whole-work conclusions. These accounts overlap, so their agreement is not a count of independent readings or proofs. [F250-A186-1-56] [F250-A206-1-82] [F250-A221-1-80] [F250-A052-1-72] [F250-A091-1-59] [F250-A062-1-99] [F250-A127-1-143] [F250-A145-1-90] [F250-A069-1-95] [F250-A030-1-66] [F250-A040-1-27] [F250-A169-1-103]

<a id="f250-a-broader-inferential-content"></a>

#### Semantic, epistemic and practical consequences of the wider reading

Several arguments in the continuous dossiers do more than illustrate the source/perfection issue. The *Ṣafadiyya* discussion of *taʾwīl* distinguishes the ultimate reality referred to, explanation of intended meaning, and the later technical redirection from a more apparent to a less apparent sense. The first can exceed a recipient's knowledge without making every revealed sentence meaningless. Audience-sensitive withholding and translation must also be distinguished from false interpretation. Its criticism applies to purported defenders of tradition who rely on weak reports or neglect sound rational arguments as well as to rationalists who exclude revelation. Collection is not authentication: a report included for reference, one offered as corroboration and one relied upon as proof have different evidential roles. The author even resists attributing wholly meaningless divine speech to a named rival school without evidence. These are restraints on his own side's method, not only attacks on opponents. [F250-A067-371-391]

The universal/particular account likewise has positive content. A universal thought is itself a particular mental occurrence whose reference can be general. The nature can be instantiated externally without an extra numerically common universal entity distributed among all individuals. Dividing a universal into species is not dividing a concrete whole into constituent parts; a human does not become several substances because bodily, sensing, willing and rational are all true of that human. Mental, external, spoken and written representations remain distinguishable, and a written token requires linguistic interpretation. A definition may distinguish its object extensionally without supplying an external genus-and-difference assembly. The argument does not abolish abstract knowledge: knowing a universal can help one know particulars, resolve a doubt or attain a good. It denies that a useful classification by itself supplies the concrete object whose existence, actions or value is at issue. [F250-A067-397-425] [F250-A067-651-655] [F250-A067-791-817]

The epistemic account does not make apparent immediacy a criterion of authority. A genuine inward prompting may be fallible; the source ranks reliable prophetic mediation over an allegedly more direct but uncontrolled inspiration. Possessing a component of prophecy, such as a truthful dream or good character, does not make its possessor a commissioned prophet. Nor do some conceded psychic capacities provide an exhaustive definition of prophethood. The reported hierarchy of saint, prophet and messenger, disputes over women and prophecy, and allegations about named writers must remain source attributions rather than newly settled intellectual history. The *Nubuwwāt* discussions similarly distinguish evidence that a person asserted something from evidence for its truth, and sincerity from immunity to error. Where revelation directs attention to an independently inspectable consideration, its rational force need not depend entirely on first granting the speaker's authority; where the only credential is the speaker's own assertion, that independent route has not yet been supplied. [F250-A067-268-287] [F250-A067-300-317] [F250-A010-32-53] [F250-A024-29-96] [F250-A036-63-103]

The historical sign arguments themselves have distinct structures. The discussion of the moon appeals not only to a transmitted assertion but to its public recitation before hearers represented as hostile and willing to question difficulties; the claimed absence of the expected contradiction then does evidential work. The Abraham-and-Lot comparison appeals to lengthy agreement across traditions under an operative non-collusion condition. Neither the social setting nor non-collusion is newly established by the reading report. Narratives of magic, inward experience, apparent transport and answered prayer are also distinguished by proposed agent, means, purpose and context, rather than sorted by unusualness alone. Some signs' occurrence before a prophet's birth or after death challenges an explanation confined to that person's then-present awareness and willing. The particular histories remain open to authentication, but their different evidential arguments should not be replaced by one generic inference from mystery to commission. [F250-A067-175-183] [F250-A067-234-252] [F250-A067-264-280] [F250-A172-19-41]

The persistence argument supplies another useful distinction. The source approves Ibn Sīnā's premise that an originated creature still requires a cause while persisting, but rejects reifying a merely conceived possible essence before it exists and rejects turning conditional necessity while something exists into intrinsic necessity. Possibility and origination indicate creaturely need; they are not efficient operations imposing need upon an otherwise independent external essence. Correspondingly, God's being necessary through himself is not his efficiently manufacturing his own existence. The discussion of beginningless series distinguishes “no gift without an earlier gift” from postponing every prospective gift until another prospective gift has first occurred. Its allowance of relative increase in unending series is a historical reply to a matching argument, not a modern set-theoretic proof. [F250-A067-457-465] [F250-A067-681-695]

The guide's *Darʾ* VIII P396–422 comparison positively ranks originating and preserving above originating alone. It also distinguishes that maker's intrinsic act from material receptivity or powers preserving an arrangement. Supplying a motion, a command, an end or one condition is not already supplying the bearer's complete original constitution. This is both an affirmative perfection comparison and a limit on its transfer: genuine local efficacy is not whole existential provision, while an effect's dependence on a condition is not automatically a defect in every contributing agent. [F250-A100-67-83]

The creation and eschatology discussions supply further scope controls. The source distinguishes the particular six-day cosmos from every possible earlier or later creature, and reads the reported pen's recorded decree in the context of this world's history through resurrection rather than as an unrestricted inventory of all creation. Its argument about throne, water and pen is an interpretation of reports, not a new chronology established here. Discussing the wording of the allegedly first-created Intellect report does not endorse its authenticity: the author calls it fabricated and then also argues that, even if granted, it would not yield the philosophical conclusion. Likewise, evidence that resurrection is possible is not already evidence that a particular narrated resurrection occurred. A surviving soul's activity, the later reunion with a body and the transformation of the cosmos are distinct theses. These arguments cannot be substituted for modern cosmology, a primary hadith collation or independent verification of the reported events. [F250-A067-531-549] [F250-A067-746-760] [F250-A067-784-795]

The practical portions distinguish an end's specification from an empty recommendation to be moderate. “Balance the faculties” does not yet tell an agent which act, occasion and degree is fitting, just as a generic medical injunction to balance humours would not identify a treatment. Knowledge without appropriate affection and practice does not by itself complete a person. The source nevertheless credits real moral reform, natural and mathematical learning, and truths within criticized philosophical systems. It qualifies accountability by whether the relevant message and proof reached the person, allows sincere error despite condemning a thesis, and explicitly requires justice toward every person, including hated opponents. Its historical legal discussions also distinguish fixed-term from indefinite treaties, different grounds and objects of fighting, and three opinions on the scope of jizya. These distinctions prevent an isolated polemical phrase from standing for the whole historical argument; they are not current legal instruction or a fresh adjudication of the cited traditions. [F250-A067-754-781] [F250-A067-826-845] [F250-A172-22-41]

Finally, the work distinguishes a counterexample from a complete explanation of why a theory failed. A genuinely established occurrence can refute a theory entailing no such occurrence, while a diagnosis must still locate the failed premise or equivocation. Conversely, the mere name *ḥujja* can designate a litigant's purported argument, including a false one, and is not an automatic truth marker. The present integration follows the same distinction: it retains positive arguments, relevant counterconsiderations and their separate scopes, without turning a source's declaration of contradiction, an editor's restoration or a report's confident assessment into an independent proof. [F250-A067-606-612] [F250-A067-833-845]

### Historical guide arguments and their prepared questions

The following source-to-question pairs preserve the work of the original Twentieth guide and its prepared specialist questions (7 October 2026). They reconstruct that inquiry, not a receipt of outside specialist review or new primary Arabic reading. The expanded guide retains these work-specific passages unchanged. Historical reading coordinates below belong to those studies, not newly inspected witnesses.

<a id="edition-guide-h02"></a>

**Shifāʾ H02: ability and actual whole production.** The guide at e49–54 and e143–151 distinguishes cooperation where neither can do the whole, alternation, and shared carrying where either has standing capacity to carry alone. It rejects the different description in which each actually performs the same whole effect independently. A permitted capacity is not separately sufficient actual partial exercise. The e145 argument begins with a Jabri interlocutor, but the Sunni reply at e146 expressly endorses the impossibility of independent production of the same numerical effect and affirms dependent creaturely causation. E150 endorses mutual-hindrance reasoning against intrinsically powerful coequals. These cannot all be dismissed as an opponent's view. The narrow whole-alone contradiction nevertheless does not establish every broader nonexclusive sufficiency claim. [F250-A100-Guide]

<a id="edition-question-cnd"></a>

**The prepared CND question.** Against that H02 argument and Darʾ 9, 016:627–650, the original questions ask which premises exclude nonexclusive entire double provision, beyond the expressly contradictory two-exclusive-producer description. Does concrete act individuation establish that exclusion independently, or already embed the ownership condition? Permitting duplication in the formal interface before CND neither answers this philosophical question nor establishes metaphysical possibility. [F250-A073-Questions]

<a id="edition-guide-m03"></a>

**Minhāj M03: agreement and voluntary particularisation.** The guide's V03L236–276 distinguishes power, will, sufficient exercise and actual effect: not everything within power is done. Complete will with power entails the relevant effect, unlike a permanently complete cause of every temporally changing effect. The source expressly discusses necessarily concordant wills, conflicting wills, shared benefit, differentiated work and foreknowledge. Knowing that an event occurs does not independently explain the productive will on which it depends. Its classification of mutually conditioned willing as partial-cause circularity must be assessed alongside its distinction between concomitance and productive borrowing; finite partial-power models do not automatically satisfy its stronger original-source profile. [F250-A100-Guide]

<a id="edition-question-agreement"></a>

**The prepared agreement question.** Minhāj V02L109 permits necessary concomitance while rejecting productive circularity; V03L272–273 discusses shared benefit, foreknowledge and mutually conditioned willing. What warrants classifying two proposed intrinsically wise concordant wills as productively dependent rather than nonproductive concomitants, and how does unilateral efficacy answer the distinction? The source did not overlook agreement or foreknowledge. An unexplained agreement is not an established rival theory. [F250-A073-Questions]

### Reading credit, source returns and original research

The earlier Arabic methodology distinguishes five activities. A continuous first pass traverses the selected received body, not an unreceived whole historical work. A local return during that traversal can be a genuine reread without being a return after the selected whole structure. A post-completion return requires evidence that the selected body was understood as a whole first; uncertain timing cannot be promoted into that category. A question- or model-triggered primary return can overlap either timing class, but its trigger and chronology need receipts. A methodological synthesis of existing records earns no additional primary-reading or proof-replay credit. These distinctions are inherited from the Arabic methodology, not new reading performed for this chapter. [Method-Arabic, lines 7–27]

The original controls are specific. The six bounded Darʾ comparison ranges followed completion of both selected electronic bodies. The Minhāj volume-two reflection occurred while volume three was still being read. Sawaʿiq's volume returns, combined interpretation and textual restorations differ in scope. Shifāʾ mixes section returns with analytical checks during a wider traversal; its whole-body appraisal is later synthesis. Jāmiʿ's middle-collection and printed 87–98 returns preceded the later scan continuation. Miftāḥ's section reflections and 100-position return did not all follow whole-body completion, whereas its later threshold and comparative returns did. Nubuwwāt's assigned-section returns preceded its whole-body appraisal; the later strong-alternatives check followed completion. Ṣafadiyya's four joins and two contextual windows are genuine returns without independently established post-whole-body timing for every window. Its later unity return lies outside the main study seal. The earlier Asbahani, Akmaliyya and al-Dāʾ receipts retain their own bounded scopes. [Method-Arabic, lines 29–47]

<a id="method-source-model-credit"></a>

Source relevance is not discovery history. AR-X07 places the rescue or overriding-good objection at N, the exclusion of a fitting exercise containing a declarative shortcoming, rather than at D's classification or P's actual conformance. Its Asbahani alignment is expressly retrospective: the record does not establish that this return caused the exact formal decomposition. AR-X05 preserves the Miftāḥ sign/converse and scoped-delegation comparisons and Nubuwwāt's custody, purpose and rival explanations. Origin, intentional adoption, mission certification and later speech content need distinct bridges. The earlier primary checks are real, while the specialized token-authentication transfer remains unimplemented. AR-X06 uses speech/carrier discrimination interpretatively, not as an Arabic premise of the copied-observation theorem. Its mathematical lead is separate; no new Arabic reread or upstream decoder replay is attributed to it. [Method-Cases, lines 55–89]

The handoff rule joins premise topics and cases to their actual result owners. Pure mathematical results can correctly have no Arabic dependency. A completed conditional proof retains its precise credit even when philosophical warrant or the proposed application is withheld. This does not turn a contextual return into a completed new source–theorem–source cycle. [Method-Cases, lines 139–141]

They do not prove the finite support/alias-cut or copying theorems, identify the actual origin map, or own HasE, scalar-fusion, normalization, controller or modal-crossing results through conceptual relevance. Repeated MF 6:73 citations and adapted versions are overlapping source families, not additional witnesses. [Method-Drive, lines 199–205, 262–298, 323]

<a id="method-drive-reproducibility"></a>

The original Drive audit's identity/range validation is historical, not a public replay performed here. Its verifier and private custody dependencies are not supplied; its packet contains no source-book bodies or page images. Only *Oneness* and the separate Arabic scan received fresh local byte checks in that audit. The other five hashes are inherited identities; their absence from inspected workspaces does not establish denial, deletion or present Drive availability, and current sharing permissions were not retested. The delivered coverage member's SHA-256, 4833ff7cf28db11f9f39972feaf46961fb67d8f7b6e43561f24e68288f932e7b, differs properly from its internal coverage-record identifier, 7e3f41a9e3596a4222c5b9c8b4ce755b2c850b46f96711aa1d5430beb57b621e. Identity and range accounting do not certify comprehension, historical authenticity or philosophical truth. [Method-Drive, lines 22, 325–338]

<a id="method-original-and-receiving-evidence"></a>

### Historical checks and the receiving boundary

The original fifteen-result handoff separates original scientific credit from receiving execution. Its historical boundary records all fifteen native owners as CANDIDATE, fresh_evidence NOT_RUN and independent_evidence_count 0. Original author and independent-review PASS records remain source-bound research evidence; their existence is neither a fresh receiving replay nor external human-specialist certification. Its validation concerns identities, cited bytes and correspondence, not a new proof or experiment. At that handoff's historical cutoff, literal HasE identity, general incidence-to-Sixth refinement and universal SourceMode warrant were distinct open boundaries; this account does not reopen any later exact-calculus result. [Method-Handoff, lines 293–299]

For the anchored-field example, qualified classification, actual conformance, faithful use/role links, an actual anchor and genuine shared-contribution connectivity yield fixed-source field coverage without CND. Guarded uniqueness additionally uses field CND and visibility. The handoff reports original independent checking, including an infinite-occurrence example of the general theorem, but does not discharge the actual interpretation premises or the open general Sixth refinement. This chapter reports that historical check; it does not repeat it. [Method-Handoff, lines 167–183]

<a id="method-late-emergence-credit"></a>

The late emergence successor adds a separate scoped result without changing the frozen fifteen rows or invalidating an older conditional theorem. Its model distinguishes essential capacity, act kind, a successive intrinsic act token and created effect. Existence is explicit in modal existential claims; freshness needs a new token identity. G-empty and all-emergent-empty differ, and stipulated actual trajectories differ from modal alternatives. Applying bearer-level ContingencyNeed to temporally novel intrinsic act tokens requires additional B-admission and whole-existence applicability. The auxiliary kind's absence from the actual trajectory makes its actual cessation clause vacuous. The source reports original author and independent-review checks, not checks performed by this synthesis. [Method-Late, lines 3–11]

Its late reading record separately credits contextual Ṣafadiyya and Darʾ volume-eight returns, ten retained Asbahani image rereads, and a bounded first reading of already acquired Darʾ volume ten, section017 lines 100–148, outside the completed volume-eight/nine study. Ṣafadiyya SF-S002-L0529–L0530 supports intrinsic-act/product discrimination in context, not a historical doctrine of simultaneous cessation of all emergent kinds. OTC-X01 connects the documented correction, source return, typed interpretation and review through their own receipts; timestamps do not reconstruct every development step. Repeated inspection does not add an independent historical witness. The earlier Arabic method audit remains retrospective and receives none of this later primary-reading credit. [Method-Late, lines 13–23]
